programme.title: Portugal's Nature Parks
programme.desc: Madeira - Portugal's autonomous island in the Atlantic Ocean, is closer to the African coast than to the mother country Portugal, from which it is separated by about 900 kilometers. The island's name comes from Portuguese sailors who claimed the uninhabited isle for themselves in 1419. Madeira means wood and that was available in abundance. Almost the entire surface was covered by dense forest. Since 1982, two-thirds of the landscape has been protected.

programme.title: North America's National Parks
programme.desc: Yellowstone National Park is an American national park located in the western United States, largely in the northwest corner of Wyoming and extending into Montana, and Idaho. It was established by the U.S. Congress and signed into law by President Ulysses S. Grant on March 1, 1872. Yellowstone was the first national park in the U.S. and is also widely held to be the first national park in the world. The park is known for its wildlife and its many geothermal features, especially Old Faithful geyser, one of its most popular. While it represents many types of biomes, the subalpine forest is the most abundant. It is part of the South Central Rockies forests ecoregion.

programme.title: North America's National Parks
programme.desc: North America’s National Parks are world famous and their breathtaking landscapes fascinate millions of visitors. This spectacular series will show you what happens beyond the lookouts. Everglades National Park is an American national park that protects the southern twenty percent of the original Everglades in Florida. The park is the largest tropical wilderness in the United States, and the largest wilderness of any kind east of the Mississippi River. An average of one million people visit the park each year. Everglades is the third-largest national park in the contiguous United States after Death Valley and Yellowstone. UNESCO declared the Everglades & Dry Tortugas Biosphere Reserve in 1976, and listed the park as a World Heritage Site in 1979, while the Ramsar Convention included the park on its list of Wetlands of International Importance in 1987. Everglades is one of only three locations in the world to appear on all three lists.

programme.title: mareTV: Newfoundland - Canada's Eastern Point
programme.desc: In Newfoundland, at the easternmost tip of North America, the landscape is pristine, dramatic, and very sparsely populated. In summer, icebergs occasionally drift along the steep cliffs. When the "Titanic" collided with an iceberg and sank just 300 miles off the coast of Newfoundland in 1912, the last radio messages were picked up in a small wooden hut on the Avalon Peninsula. Today, most Newfoundlanders live on Avalon. There are particularly many seabirds here. In Witless Bay, the newborn puffins are ready for their first descent into the Atlantic. But some stray onto the coastal road, attracted by the lights of the hotels and restaurants. In doing so, they run the risk of being run over. A team of volunteers saves the lives of countless young birds: The Puffin & Petrel Patrol goes out at night dressed in high-visibility vests to collect the puffins. Biologist Sabrina Wilhelm then brings them back to Green Island, home to the largest puffin colony in North America. Here, the birds catch up on what they should have done long ago: the first dive of their lives.

programme.title: Magical Moors
programme.desc: Wide open heaths, windswept and barren in winter, are transformed into wonderful carpets of white, fluffy cotton grass in summer. Large bears and wolves roam alongside delicately fluttering butterflies, the bubbling calls of black grouse and the enchanting trills of the great snipe. Moors, bogs and wetlands can be found all over in Europe. Everyone has at least heard about this habitat but most know little about it. It is an ancient yet largely unknown set of landscapes that is full of enchanting surprises. On a warm spring day, poisonous adders emerge from hiding to perform their impressive mating dance. As dusk falls, snipe gather on traditional leks, leaping and singing to impress the opposite sex. And deep down in the boggy marshes, glittering emeralds of sticky dew lure insects into the deadly arms of meat-eating plants. Magical Moors captures the quiet beauty of a spectacular landscape, and its often elusive wildlife, in stunning detail.

programme.title: Hot Roads - The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads
programme.desc: It is one of the wildest roads in Asia: the Trans Sulawesi Highway. The adventurous road leads through Indonesia's fourth-largest island and takes people to spectacular destinations. To beautiful beaches, turbulent cities, or unique primeval forests.

programme.title: Hot Roads - The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads
programme.desc: Far out in the "Wild West" of Canada lies Bella Coola. If you want to get to the small town on the Pacific, you have no choice: there is only one road leading there, the Bella Coola Highway. It is constantly monitored and yet remains dangerous. Gravel roads, narrow hairpin bends and steep mountain slopes make the highway in British Columbia a particular challenge.

programme.title: Hot Roads - The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads
programme.desc: In the extreme north-east of Norway known as the Finnmark region, winters are freezing cold and snowy. Due to the location on the Arctic Ocean, the roads are prone to snow drifts. Every metre is a challenge and a journey into risk. An adventure for all those who set off into the fascinating and unique landscape, through a seemingly endless desert of snow.

programme.title: The most spectacular change of seasons - Spring
programme.desc: This film explores Central Europe and presents the nature from a perspective you have never seen before. Fascinating landscape footage in high-quality HD technology, coupled with spectacular Cineflex aerial views, take us on a journey through the hitherto unknown blazes of colour of the Central European region and its inhabitants. We show you paradise on earth and demonstrate how climate and astronomy determine our life cycle. While seasons change, we visit several different European habitats that - in their diversity, are exemplary of a Central European region. Mountains, water, forests and meadows: we return to each of these habitats at different times of the year and show how the rhythm of life of each of our protagonists follows nature's clock. The four seasons determine all of the coming and passing away; a highly complex interplay in the universe of life. We explore the wondrous worlds of the mysterious cycle of nature together with extraordinary people. Breathtaking landscapes enable us to experience the change of seasons at first hand.

programme.title: The Sun - Inferno in the Sky
programme.desc: On July 23rd, 2012, a massive eruption on the sun hurls a colossal cloud of solar matter into space. It’s the most severe sunstorm in 150 years. Fortunately, the Earth is not in the direct path of this solar ejection. But it’s only a matter of time before a violent solar storm hits us. When these clouds of charged matter reach our planet, they can wreak havoc in electrical systems.

programme.title: Portugal's Nature Parks
programme.desc: Madeira - Portugal's autonomous island in the Atlantic Ocean, is closer to the African coast than to the mother country Portugal, from which it is separated by about 900 kilometers. The island's name comes from Portuguese sailors who claimed the uninhabited isle for themselves in 1419. Madeira means wood and that was available in abundance. Almost the entire surface was covered by dense forest. Since 1982, two-thirds of the landscape has been protected.

programme.title: Portugal's Nature Parks
programme.desc: The highest mountain range in Portugal is the Serra da Estrela. The episode embarks on a voyage of discovery to adventurous rock formations and villages steeped in tradition. The nature park is the largest protected area on the Iberian peninsula. In the mountain range we accompany the young scientist Ana Matos, who wants to breathe new life into old traditions, and cheese maker Maria Natália Lopes. She watches over more than 350 sheeps.

programme.title: Wild Alpine Rivers - Life in the Extreme
programme.desc: What would happen to the mountains without water? They would turn into deserts, devoid of life and vegetation. But there are very few mountains without water on our planet. They take care of this themselves, creating their life’s element and taking water directly from the sky by entrapping the clouds around them. This water then collects on the flanks of the mountains, where it turns from rivulets into rivers, that flow out into the oceans. Mountains and water are symbiotic, a cycle that keeps life on earth going. Mountain streams slowly move along meadows before, only moments later, turning into the spray of waterfalls or small mystic lakes. What kind of life can be found in and around this mysterious cosmos? We will investigate the world of the rare Danube salmon and be there to see the Danube bleak spawn. We will follow giant wels catfish into their hideouts, see great crested grebes on their underwater hunting. We go diving under the ice of frozen mountain streams and lakes, discovering life where none was thought possible.

programme.title: Europe's far North - Lofoten and the Arctic Ocean
programme.desc: Lofoten is the rugged archipelago in the Norwegian Arctic Ocean. Whoever arrives here is really at the end. Moskenes is the end of the line, and anyone who wants to go further needs a boat or a plane. The only way to get to the open sea is via the Maelstrom, which is quite dangerous. On the outermost headland, there are only a few ruins left. The last inhabitants are long gone, a supply was hardly possible. But fishermen are on the way, mainly to catch cod. And there is the coastal administration, which takes care of broken sea marks and lighthouses. A visit to one of the luxurious ships of the Hurtig Line is not to be missed. They shuttle off rough coasts on an eleven-day trip between the Russian border and southern Norway. A floating workplace for a wide variety of professions. The island of Andøya is not served by the Hurtiglinie. It lies too far out in the Atlantic. One of the most important observatories in Europe is located here. A young woman, Sandra Blindheim, is the boss. She is responsible for the large laser that delivers important information to scientists around the world. On clear winter nights, there is a wonderful panoramic view of the aurora borealis.

programme.title: Myths of the Congo - Apes and Aliens
programme.desc: The Congo, mighty and deep like no other river - yet still a retreat and a habitat for several of our world's strangest animals. Our closest relatives live deep inside the dense jungles: three of the four giant ape species have made the Congo basin their home. Rich in extraordinary footage, the second episode of "Myths of the Congo" also presents exciting insights into one of the most mysterious and dangerous regions on earth.

programme.title: Myths of the Congo - Deep and Dangerous
programme.desc: The river that swallows all rivers - this is what the natives call it. In reality, the Congo, when considering its water masses, is the second largest and the deepest river in the world. At its source in the north of Zambia, it starts out as a mere trickle, but on its journey westwards it grows and grows, becoming ever mightier and with it, the animals, too: the shoebill stork hides in the dense papyrus. Metre-long pythons hunt for their prey in trees and huge hippos fight for power and respect in the water. To survive in the Congo, animals have to adapt to extreme conditions. Here, evolution has spawned unique creatures: fish with lungs, wings and those that go hunting on land. The Congo River feeds the second largest rainforest on earth. Here is the home of the forest elephant. Time and again, they are summoned to this one, magic place: the Dzanga Bay. Countless other forest dwellers join them. What makes this place so special?

programme.title: mareTV: Sardinia - Magical Island in the Mediterranean
programme.desc: Sardinia is the second-largest island in the Mediterranean. The Sardin-ians themselves say it's a "continent for itself", a virtual world of its own, full of magic: A beach, gleaming in unreal pink shades, red corals protect against the evil eye and the inhabitants seem to remain forever young. On Sardinia, the owners of luxury yachts adopt sheep, fish have gold in their bellies and a giant mussel supplies the material for legendary sea silk. No one is surprised, that the Madonna goes on a sea cruise once a year.

programme.title: Bavarian Forest - Deep, Dark and Enchanted
programme.desc: After an unusual mass reproduction of bark beetles in the nineties, thousands hectares of old spruce forest were destroyed. Soon after, a new, healthier forest started to grow – a new primeval forest. Within a few years, in place of the former monoculture, a diverse forest developed, rich in spruces, ashes, beech and fir trees. Naturally, this diversity has in turn attracted new animal and plant species. Even lynx and otters returned and made Bavaria their home again.

programme.title: Deadly Roads
programme.desc: Some risks on these autoroutes have natural causes: Extreme weather, avalanches and landslides. In some areas, the locals even believe that evil spirits kill travelers. But many of the dangers are man-made: robbers or terrorists lie in wait for travelers, and tough labor pressures, social hardship and greedy mass-transit businesses also cause tragic driving accidents around the world. In the 20th century alone, 35 million people died on roads worldwide - plus 1.5 billion injured! With the two-part "Death Roads - On the Road at the Limit," phoenix offers a documentary road movie along the world's most dangerous car routes.

programme.title: Deadly Roads
programme.desc: Roads are much more than just gray strips of asphalt that allow us to travel and trade. For centuries they have been lifelines of mankind, full of stories and history - and in certain countries and areas they also hold great dangers, much human suffering and death. Documentary filmmaker Oliver G. Becker ventured onto dangerous roads in New Zealand, Scotland and Australia for phoenix.

programme.title: mareTV: Corsica - Fascinating Mountain World in the Mediterranean
programme.desc: Corsica looks like an alpine landscape in the Mediterranean, an island with dramatic rock formations, romantic bays and proud inhabitants who see themselves first and foremost as Corsicans and only then as French. The Greeks in ancient times called the island Kalliste: the beautiful. We explore this fascinating mountain world in the Mediterranean.

programme.title: Wild Faces of Switzerland - Winter in the Swiss Alps
programme.desc: In the heart of Europe lies Switzerland. It’s a surprisingly big little country: small in area, but big on natural beauty. And, like its many languages and cultures, its scenic diversity is something really special, too: from mighty Alps, dense forests and lush green valleys, to mysterious moors and roaring waterfalls. Mediterranean lakes and craggy rock landscapes are all close together in one small geographical location. Switzerland has many wild faces – some familiar and some hidden. It’s a country that’s astonishingly rich in variety, wilderness and scenic wonder. Each episode of the series seeks to do justice to this diversity.

programme.title: Chiemgau, A Changing Landscape
programme.desc: A few thousand years ago, there were bare moraine ridges and barren meltwater valleys here. A landscape born in the last ice age, characterized by the edge of the Alps, gentle hills, moors, and lakes. And by cultural richness, not only on the islands in Lake Chiemsee, with their famous monasteries and castles. Long before King Ludwig II, the first people settled in the Chiemgau region. Finds of hunting weapons from the Neanderthal era prove that the land was inhabited even during the ice age, probably because there was plenty of game to hunt. During the Bronze Age, one of the most important trade routes from the mountains to the Alpine foothills passed through here. Then came the Celts and the Romans.

programme.title: Chiemgau, A Changing Landscape
programme.desc: Three times in the past two decades, the Chiemsee area has experienced "once-in-a-century" floods. Climate, wildlife, and landscape have changed, and it seems this transformation is accelerating. Species living in the flood zones are developing sophisticated survival strategies. Knot ants, for instance, place their queen in the middle and form a raft with their bodies, even conquering new habitats. Flooding is less of a disaster for nature and impacts humans more significantly.

programme.title: Project Antarctica
programme.desc: Why don't you do something sensible? - Tim, Michael and Dennis have heard this sentence more than once since their school days when they professed their dream jobs: Artist, photographer, filmmaker. And they went on to say that some dreams had to remain dreams, that work didn't have to be fun, but above all that it had to pay enough and be safe. A few years later, the three are working on their joint feature film. They put all their eggs in one basket and are determined to invest two years of working time to achieve their goal. Unpaid. It's not just any goal: the three want to travel to Antarctica. They want to find out whether it is possible to reach even the most distant destinations if you only want to. With ten boxes full of equipment, they set off on the 14,000 km journey to Antarctica. And thus on the journey of a lifetime...

programme.title: Project Antarctica
programme.desc: Why don't you do something sensible? - Tim, Michael and Dennis have heard this sentence more than once since their school days when they professed their dream jobs: Artist, photographer, filmmaker. And they went on to say that some dreams had to remain dreams, that work didn't have to be fun, but above all that it had to pay enough and be safe. A few years later, the three are working on their joint feature film. They put all their eggs in one basket and are determined to invest two years of working time to achieve their goal. Unpaid. It's not just any goal: the three want to travel to Antarctica. They want to find out whether it is possible to reach even the most distant destinations if you only want to. With ten boxes full of equipment, they set off on the 14,000 km journey to Antarctica. And thus on the journey of a lifetime...

programme.title: North Macedonia: Between Traditional Dances and Mini Navy
programme.desc: Northern Macedonia emerged from being a once constituent republic of the former Yugoslavia. Anyone wishing to discover unknown worlds has every chance of finding them in this young Balkan country, full of imposing mountains, lakes of crystal-clear water, original villages and centuries-old customs. Nevertheless, Northern Macedonia, which borders Serbia in the north and Greece in the south, considered to be one of the poorest countries in Europe.

programme.title: The U.S. East Coast
programme.sub-title: The U.S. East Coast, The City and the Sea
programme.desc: The journey up the coast continues through Delaware to suburban New Jersey, and onwards into the heart of Manhattan. In Delaware, famous as a corporate tax haven, we visit a winery. In New York City we zip around with a bicycle courier and then head out to Long Island for oysters.

programme.title: The U.S. East Coast
programme.sub-title: The U.S. East Coast, Surf And Turf
programme.desc: New Hampshire has only 19 kilometers of coastline and short summers, all the more reason Shauna Fraser takes every opportunity to be by the sea. In the sheltered harbor of Rye, Shauna also targets inner attitude with yoga on a paddleboard.

programme.title: Model And The Bushmen, The
programme.desc: This is the story of an incredible adventure: a young woman from Norway moves into the wild and joins the last Bushmen hunters in Namibia. Every morning, the women set out to forage and the men sneak into the bush to hunt, carrying little else but homemade bows and arrows as they walk through the wilderness.

programme.title: Meteor Menace
programme.desc: On February 15th, 2013, out of the blue, a meteorite exploded in the earth’s atmosphere above the Russian region of Chelyabinsk. The event is a reminder of the ever-present 'Meteor Menace' and the need to understand more about these missiles from outer space.

programme.title: Children of the Sun
programme.desc: Butterflies surely are the most fancied species inside the insect world. Their beautiful colouring and their graceful flight appeal to everyone. There are close to 4000 types of Butterflies – today many of them are endangered due to the loss of their habitat.

programme.title: Children of the Sun
programme.sub-title: Children of the Sun - Wild Bees
programme.desc: Most people associate honey producing insects with the name “BEE“. Few realize that there are over 560 different species of bees - most of them live their lives “busy as a bee“ but some “abuse“ other insects and others are even known to be murderers. The film “Wild Bees” shows the incredible diversity and the stunning adaptations of our “BEES” to various habitats and diverse living conditions. Fascinating fights, sensational performances, imposing structures and colorful individuals – the world of “Wild Bees” offers all of this and more.

programme.title: Bavaria's Alpine Kingdom
programme.desc: There are sparkling palaces from ice and snow, like those found in a fairytale. The icy castles are the phenomenal work of Mother Nature but man had a hand in the magnificent stone castles of the region. The spectacular and histrionic mountains of the Bavarian Alps challenge wildlife and the people who live there and the rocky ramparts of this mountain kingdom are built of limestone and fossil rocks that tell of its origins beneath the sea. Millions of visitors from all over the world come to Bavaria every year to witness the mysticism of the landscape. Kings and Queens, tourist and locals, all are welcomed in the fantastic alpine kingdom. Early summer often comes with the threat of storms that bring floods that scour the land and threaten many creatures. But farmers risk these dangers to take their herds to the highest pastures, where they can graze on the sweetest flower-filled meadows. And later from the high-quality milk produced by their herds, the famers make highly prized cheese. Humankind lives among eagle owls, chamoix, wild cats, stoats and ravens up in these mountains.

programme.title: Alpine Lakes - Dark Depths and Icy Heights
programme.desc: This is a nature documentary, which leads us into the fascinating world of deep mountain lakes. We conquer ice palaces of unsuspected beauty. In the freezers, in which elves, fairies and mountain trolls once did their mischief, we move, using a special breathing technique and with special cameras in search of nocturnal hunters, whose eyes are equipped with residual light amplifying receptors.

programme.title: Hot Roads - The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads
programme.desc: Tanzania is known for its national parks, vast landscapes and wild roads. They make traveling a real adventure. We travel in trucks, buses and off-road vehicles from the Indian Ocean via the Serengeti to Lake Victoria, accompany huge herds of wildebeest, observe lions and rhinos - and show the lives of the people who live on and along the roads.

programme.title: Hot Roads - The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads
programme.desc: In the far north-east of Georgia, on the border with Russia, the Abano Pass leads to lofty heights. At almost 3000 metres it is the highest passable road in the Great Caucasus. It winds its way up dizzyingly steep slopes. On wild paths, it leads through a fascinating landscape.

programme.title: Hot Roads - The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads
programme.desc: India's state of Rajasthan is known for its ancient palaces, vast landscapes - and wild transport routes. For thousands of years, dromedaries served as the most important means of transport. Today, India's roads are considered fast-paced, chaotic and unpredictable. On a journey through the desert state, we discover its rough roads.

programme.title: Stories of the Mediterranean Forest: Sierra Morena
programme.desc: The Mediterranean Basin is one of the planet’s most biologically rich and complex regions. The crossroads of Europe, Asia and Africa is considered to be one of Earth’s biodiversity hotspots. A vast number of both animal and plant species unique to the region live in its various habitats. The Mediterranean Basin is located in one of the planet’s temperate zones. The subtropical climate makes it colder and wet here in winter, hot and dry in summer and mild and rainy in autumn and spring.

programme.title: Wild Switzerland
programme.desc: Gentle, green meadows, rugged rock faces, mysterious lakes, dense forests, tall mountains, low-lying river deltas, quietly meandering mountain streams and smack dab in the middle, a unique fauna - THIS is Switzerland! We trace the elementary power of nature and present animals and plants in landscapes that have hardly ever been touched by mankind. Switzerland is an alpine country, but it is also Europe's surge tank. Rivers such as the Rhine and the Rhone have their sources here. Glaciers, crevasses, icy cold caves and the underwater dome of the Verzasca are the unusual settings we chose for this film. We meet with rare, selected animal species and present their behavioural patterns, such as the Swiss or Arven jay, the lynx and albino catfish. Cold, wind, snow and extreme locations demand adaptation that make us marvel.

programme.title: North America's National Parks
programme.desc: Yosemite National Park is a place of superlatives: with towering cliffs and giant sequoias, home to coyotes, black bears and the most elusive of all: the bobcat. Watch this documentary with ist spectacular shots, aerial views and time-lapse shots and learn some new facts about the biodiversity in one of North Americas most spectacular National Parks.

programme.title: North America's National Parks
programme.sub-title: America's National Parks - Great Smoky Mountains
programme.desc: Great Smoky Mountains National Park is an American national park in the southeastern United States, with parts in Tennessee and North Carolina. The park straddles the ridgeline of the Great Smoky Mountains, part of the Blue Ridge Mountains, which are a division of the larger Appalachian Mountain chain. The park contains some of the highest mountains in eastern North America, including Clingmans Dome, Mount Guyot, and Mount Le Conte. The border between the two states runs northeast to southwest through the center of the park. The Appalachian Trail passes through the center of the park on its route from Georgia to Maine. With 12.5 million visitors in 2019, the Great Smoky Mountains National Park is the most visited national park in the United States.

programme.title: Rewilding: Back to Nature
programme.desc: Worldwide, there are various projects and approaches to give nature more space again. The aim is to create larger wilderness areas that develop with hardly any influence of humans - by reintroducing so-called key animal species and creating a network of wilderness corridors across entire continents. Rewilding promises to be a cost-effective form of conservation in which we can boost biodiversity and protect the climate.

programme.title: Montenegro - From the Black Mountains to the Beach
programme.desc: The Balkan land of Montenegro owes its name to the Black Mountains. But there is so much more: steep cliffs, deep gorges, picturesque lakes, orthodox monasteries, Venetian architecture, sandy beaches and even fjords like those of Norway. There are three climate zones alone in the Adriatic. The inhabitants still try to find their way between the challenges of a post-socialist system, the much-vaunted Balkan remoteness and the opportunities of a still almost completely undiscovered tourist destination in Europe.

programme.title: Legendary Paddle Steamers
programme.sub-title: Following the Scottish West Coast with "Waverley"
programme.desc: Rugged coasts, untouched nature and the rough climate of the Atlantic characterize the landscape on the west coast of Scotland. In the sounds and lochs of the Scottish West, "Waverley", the last seaworthy passenger steamship in the world, appears once a year. The side-wheel steamer was built in 1947 to carry out short ferry passages on the Clyde River. Today, "Waverley" circumnavigates almost all of Great Britain. The impressive ship was sold to the "Paddle Steamer Preservation Society" in 1974 for the symbolic price of one English pound. Since then, she starts her season off the Western Isles in Scotland every year in May.

programme.title: Legendary Paddle Steamers
programme.sub-title: Across the lake Vierwaldstättersee with the “Unterwalden”
programme.desc: Lake Lucerne in the heart of Switzerland stretches from the foothills of the Alps to the first three-thousand-meter peaks of the high mountains. Home waters of the paddle steamer Unterwalden. For two and a half years she was not on the water. Now, after the biggest renovation in her history, the life of the 110-year-old paddle steamer is starting all over again. Her first voyages, with all the imponderables and challenges for the crew, take her into a diverse, wild landscape, right into the mystical heart of Switzerland. In their territory, scenic contrasts collide: barren high moorland and gently rolling alpine meadows, modern tourist resorts and quiet mountain villages, caves hidden deep in the earth and snow-covered two-thousand-meter peaks. The Unterwalden is part of the oldest and largest fleet of paddle steamers so high above the sea. Here on Lake Lucerne, according to national legend, the three original cantons swore eternal allegiance to each other over seven hundred years ago. A land around which countless myths entwine and whose lifeline since the opening of the Gotthard Pass in the thirteenth century was the shipping traffic on the lake.

programme.title: Fertile Floods - Croatia's Wetlands
programme.desc: Every year, in the middle of Croatia, it's the same story: after the annual snowmelt, a huge flood wave spills out of the Alps toward Zagreb and Belgrade. This leads to an increase in the River Sava's water levels of some ten metres. The contents of more than ten billion bathtubs floods an area the size of Lake Constance, often for months on end, yet still the Croatian and Serbian capital is spared a flood disaster. One of the reasons for this is the fact that the Sava is able to flow unhindered. The annual floods not only create a natural retention reservoir for flood control: alongside the Sava lies a natural paradise, unique in Central Europe. In the species-rich, alluvial flood forests of the last major meadow landscapes of the continent, enormous predatory fish like the catfish lie in wait for prey. The fertile floodplains of the Sava are an important resting place for more than 240 bird species, including Hoopoe, great crested Grebe, little Egret, common snipe and pied Avocet. Old, domestic livestock breeds like the Turopolje pig and Posavina horse spend almost the entire year in the floodplains. They appreciate the alluvial meadows, keep puddles and mudholes open whilst wallowing and, as living lawnmowers, they ensure that the moist meadows aren't transformed into dense oak forests. Thanks to this traditional pasture farming, more than 700 pairs of white stork alone breed in the Lonjsko Polje National Park. The Sava Floodplains allow us to glance into the past of our continent and at the same time, illustrate just how flood protection for major towns can be perfected.

programme.title: Moon, The: Our Gateway To The Universe
programme.desc: We are on the verge of a new age of exploration: besides the plans of NASA and other space agencies, over the next years also privately financed teams are going to send unmanned vehicles to the Moon. The goal is to find a cheap and efficient way to travel there on a regular basis, and in the long term to build a permanent human base.

programme.title: Baltic National Parks
programme.desc: Soomaa National Park is one of Europes wettest wilderness areas. Floods, forests and wetlands create a landscape where canoes replace roads during the fifth season.

programme.title: Broad City: Along Came Molly
programme.desc: Abbi, Ilana och Bevers säljer Abbis saker i New York City, Abbi får biljetter till Lil Wayne, och tjejerna gör en 'tripp'.

programme.title: Broad City: Broad City
programme.desc: Brudarna säger hej då.

programme.title: Broad City: What A Wonderful World
programme.desc: Ilana får nys om en hemlig Lil Wayne-konsert. Tillsammans med Abbi bufflar hon sig fram i New York. Tjejerna låter inget hindra dem från att skrapa ihop tillräckligt med pengar för biljetterna.

programme.title: Broad City: Stolen Phone
programme.desc: Efter att ha försökt att hitta killar på Facebook beslutar sig Abbi och Ilana att försöka hitta killar i 'verkligheten'.

programme.title: Broad City: Working Girls
programme.desc: Ilana försöker tjäna lite extrapengar i 'temp game'. Abbi lovar sin granne att vänta in hans paket, men när hon missar leveransen måste hon ta sig till världens ände för att hitta det.

programme.title: Broad City: The Lockout
programme.desc: När Abbi sanerar sin lägenhet mot ohyra och Ilana tappar bort sina nycklar tvingas tjejerna att bo på gatan - just när Abbi har sin första konstutställning.

programme.title: Broad City: P*$$Y Weed
programme.desc: Tjejerna måste växa upp! Abbi vill köpa sin egen marijuana, som en vuxen kvinna, medan Ilana måste tackla skatten på egen hand. Och, tjejerna är höga som hus.

programme.title: Broad City: Fattest Asses
programme.desc: När Abbi förstår att hon är för snäll, ser hon till att bli mer bitchig. Ilana beslutar sig för att nå sin fulla potential. De går på ett exklusivt party och träffar några äventyrliga dj:ar. Nu kan inget gå fel.

programme.title: Broad City: Hurricane Wanda
programme.desc: Abbi och Ilana rider ut en kommande storm med Jaimé, Lincoln och Jeremy. Tyvärr får de också sällskap av Bevers och hans syster. De spelar 'Who Done It?' medan stormen rasar utanför.

programme.title: Broad City: In Heat
programme.desc: Ilana letar febrilt efter en sista-minutenpresent till Lincoln medan Abbi försöker att hitta en luftkonditionering för att få det svalt i sovrummet.

programme.title: Broad City: Mochalatta Chills
programme.desc: Det dyker upp nya möjligheter när Abbi äntligen lyckas att träna någon på Soulstice och Ilana gör succé som företagshöjdare.

programme.title: Broad City: Wisdom Teeth
programme.desc: Abbi måste dra ut sina visdomständer och Ilana ser det som sin plikt att sköta om henne tills hon mår bättre - vilket självklart innebär en massa 'medikamenter' och en påtaglig brist på tillsyn.

programme.title: Broad City: Knockoffs
programme.desc: Abbi och Jeremy går på en dejt som slutar med en överraskning medan Ilana och hennes mamma letar överallt efter den perfekta handväskan.

programme.title: Broad City: Hashtag FOMO
programme.desc: Tjejerna letar efter den perfekta festen, vilket avslöjar en underlig och surrealistisk sida hos Abbi som bekräftar Ilanas värsta farhågor.

programme.title: Broad City: Citizen Ship
programme.desc: Gänget ska fira att Jaime blivit amerikansk medborgare men Bevers leder Abbi och Ilana på avvägar genom att lova dem gratissprit. Under tiden får Lincoln och Jaime klara sig själva bland alla advokater.

programme.title: Broad City: Coat Check
programme.desc: Abbi ger sig av för att återfinna en försvunnen kappa medan Ilana utforskar en ny romans - som dock känns besynnerligt välbekant.

programme.title: Broad City: St. Mark's
programme.desc: När tjejerna firar Ilanas 23-årsdag blir de avbrutna av en tonåring på rymmen vilket leder till en vild jakt runt St. Mark's Place.

programme.title: Broad City: Two Chainz
programme.desc: Abbi och Ilana får klädproblem på väg till en väninnas utställning samtidigt som de är i desperat behov av en offentlig toalett.

programme.title: Broad City: Co-Op
programme.desc: Abbi låtsas vara Ilana för att kunna ta över hennes arbetspass i affären medan Ilana åker till Long Island för ett viktigt läkarbesök.

programme.title: Broad City: Game Over
programme.desc: Ilana får en ny chans hos Deals, Deals, Deals och Abbi försöker hålla sin tävlingsinriktade sida i schack när jobbet anordnar Soulstice Games.

programme.title: Broad City: Rat Pack
programme.desc: När Jaime och Ilana får en dyr räkning av skadedjursbekämparen bestämmer de sig för att ha en fest för att få in pengarna. Samtidigt så försöker Abbi att träffa nya människor.

programme.title: Broad City: 2016
programme.desc: Ilana hittar sitt nya kall samtidigt som Abbi står inför det mest fruktade stället i världen: Bilprovningen.

programme.title: Broad City: Philadelphia
programme.desc: Abbi och Ilana åker till Philadelphia för att besöka Abbis hemstad. Men när Abbi inser att hon gjorde ett stort misstag i high school förvandlas det till att hon och Ilana måste göra botgöring.

programme.title: Broad City: B&B-NYC
programme.desc: Abbi och Ilana anmäler sina lägenheter till B&B-NYC för att få ihop lite extra stålar.

programme.title: Broad City: Burning Bridges
programme.desc: Ilanas föräldrar kommer till stan för att fira sin bröllopsdag, men både Abbi och Ilana har svårt att fira eftersom de har problem i sina förhållanden.

programme.title: Broad City: Getting There
programme.desc: Abbi och Ilana ska resa bort, men bara att ta sig till flygplatsen visar sig bli mycket svårare än vad de trodde.

programme.title: Broad City: Jews on a Plane
programme.desc: Abbi får plötsligt mens ombord på ett flygplan, så hon och Ilana gör allt för att få tag på en tampong.

programme.title: Broad City: Sliding Doors
programme.desc: En vårdag 2011 träffas Abbi och Ilana för första gången.

programme.title: Broad City: Twaining Day
programme.desc: Abbis kortvariga återkomst till Soulstice blir intressant när hon får chansen hon alltid har drömt om. Ilana får nytt jobb på en restaurang.

programme.title: Broad City: Just the Tips
programme.desc: Ilana shoppar loss med sina servitrispengar, och Abbi njuter av ett nytt förhållande. Senare på kvällen träffar tjejerna en gammal kompis på en fest.

programme.title: Broad City: Mushrooms
programme.desc: Abbi och Ilana tar svampar och får en händelserik tripp.

programme.title: Broad City: Abbi's Mom
programme.desc: Abbis mamma är på besök i stan, och Ilana försöker klara den hektiska arbetskulturen på Sushi Mambeaux medan hon hanterar sin årstidsbundna depression.

programme.title: Broad City: Witches
programme.desc: Abbi känner sig gammal när hon upptäcker ett grått hår. Ilana träffar en sexterapeut.

programme.title: Broad City: Florida
programme.desc: Abbi, Ilana, Eliot och Bobbi åker till Florida för att städa ur farmor Esthers lägenhet.

programme.title: Broad City: House Sitting
programme.desc: Abbi, Ilana, Jaime och Lincoln passar familjen Strands hus. Ilana och Lincoln definierar sin relation, och Abbi har en Bumbledejt med en man från förr.

programme.title: Broad City: Bed Bugs
programme.desc: En fin, ny väska ger Abbi självförtroende under arbetslösheten. Ilana och Jaimé får hantera en i New York City oundviklig mardröm.

programme.title: Broad City: Friendiversary
programme.desc: Tjejernas firande av 'kompisårsdagen' blir plötsligt farlig när de bevittnar nåt hemskt.

programme.title: Broad City: Stories

programme.title: Äventyrsdags: Shh!
programme.desc: Ta tag i din vän, vi åker till ett avlägset land. Med hunden Jake och människan Finn, dom har så roligt jämt.

programme.title: Äventyrsdags: Friaren
programme.desc: Pepparmintbutlern tycker att Prinsessan Bubbelgum spenderar alldeles för mycket tid i sitt labb och bestämmer att hon ska träffa en av sina friare.

programme.title: Äventyrsdags: Det är över
programme.desc: Ta tag i din vän, vi åker till ett avlägset land. Med hunden Jake och människan Finn, dom har så roligt jämt.

programme.title: Regular Show: Träffade av blixten

programme.title: Regular Show: Partyhästens återkomst
programme.desc: Mordecai och Rigby vill hjälpa Partyhästen att bli ihop med sin flickvän igen.

programme.title: Regular Show: Sömncykel

programme.title: Regular Show: Bara vänner

programme.title: Gumballs fantastiska värld: Medvetenheten
programme.desc: Under Grönaveckan råkar Gumball säga att plantor är meningslösa. Detta hör Lesley. Nu måste Gumball visa att han visst vet varför plantor är viktiga.

programme.title: Gumballs fantastiska värld: Pappret

programme.title: Gumballs fantastiska värld: Dramat

programme.title: Gumballs fantastiska värld: Kompisen
programme.desc: Anais och tuffe Jamie blir anklagade för samma teknologiska brott. De tvingas slå sig ihop för att hitta den riktiga förövaren och bevisa sin oskuld.

programme.title: Kuka uskaltaa
programme.desc: Albin ja Stig ovat tasaveroisia. Eivät ainoastaan mitä tulee kastematojen syömiseen, vaan myös korkealle hyppäämisessä. He hyppivät sahalla, joella ja puissa ja lyövät lopuksi vetoa kaikkein hurjimmasta - kuka uskaltaa hypätä ladon katolta?

programme.title: Saariston lasten suuri seikkailu
programme.desc: Pikku Ninni haaksirikkoutuu autiolle saarelle yhdessä Pampulan, Pellen ja Stinan kanssa. Oikeastaan heidän ei ollut tarkoitus kuin käydä saarella, mutta Ninni ei olekaan aivan niin hyvä köyttämään veneitä rantaan kuin luuli! Saarella majailee myös kaksi salakuljettajaa, joiden veneen Ninni myöskin sitoi lujasti kiinni...

programme.title: Rosa: The Movie
programme.desc: Sarjakuvasta koko illan elokuvaksi - 14-vuotias Rosa on poptähti mielikuvituksessaan, mutta todellisuudessa hänellä on poikakaveriongelmia.

programme.title: Lasse-Maijan etsivätoimisto
programme.desc: Lehtimysteeri. Poliisimestarista tehdään piparkakkuvaras, ja monia muita vallilalaisia syytetään oudosti paikallislehdessä. Kuka on taitavien valeartikkelien takana? Koko perheen sarja perustuu Martin Widmarkin ja Helena Willisin rakastettuihin kirjoihin. Anders Jansson esittää Vallilan lahjatonta poliisimestaria. 2021

programme.title: Tervetuloa Sjölyckaniin!
programme.desc: Ruokasota. Lilyllä on raskauden takia hikiset paikat, ja hän tekee sopimuksen Söderbergin kanssa. Erimielisyys yhteisistä aterioista johtaa asemasotaan. Ruotsalainen komediasarja, johon on helppo samastua. Millaisia ongelmia voi syntyä, kun kolme sukupolvea kokoontuu kesäpaikkaan saaristoon? Ruotsi 2019

programme.title: Opiskelijakämppä
programme.desc: Oliver pakottaa Jennyn siivomaamaan Jörgenin kämpän - muuten hän paljastaa Jennyn salaisuuden. Saga kutsuu Jennyn piknikille, mutta jokin on pielessä. 20-vuotias Jenny jättää Eskilstunan lukeakseen psykologiksi Uppsalassa. Opiskelijakämpässä hän tapaa karismaattiset klubittajat Sagan ja Oliverin, jotka jo ensimmäisenä iltana houkuttelevat Jennyn tekemään päätöksen, jolla on tuhoisat seuraukset... Ruotsi 2022

programme.title: Happy fucking Pride
programme.desc: “Fuck the Pain Away”. On viikon kohokohdan, kaikkien aikojen bileiden aika! Dilan haluaa jäädä kotiin, mutta hänet suostutellaan mukaan. Ninan ja Saschan suhde jännittyy. Tukholma kuplii odotuksia Pride-viikon alkaessa. Treffejä odottava pikkukaupungin poika Dilan, näennäisen itsevarma mutta satutettu huippumeklari Ari ja tämän juuri jätetty kaveri Nina navigoivat vauhdikkaiden kesäpäivien ja kuumien kesäöiden läpi. Ruotsi 2024

programme.title: Bert (dubattu suomeksi)
programme.desc: Jätetty. Sarja alkaa. 14-vuotias Bert on tullut jätetyksi ja on täysin alamaissa. Elämä jatkuu bändiharjoitusten merkeissä, ja matkalla kotiin Bert rakastuu. Ruotsalainen komediasarja teini-ikäisestä Bertistä ikuisine rakkausongelmineen. Sarja perustuu Anders Jacobssonin ja Sören Olssonin kirjoihin. 2020

programme.title: Käsi sydämellä
programme.desc: Avan mielestä suhde Johniin etenee liian nopeasti, ja hän haluaa ottaa askeleen takaisin. Markus antaa Johnille hyvää tarkoittavia neuvoja. Tukholmalaisella pariterapeutilla Avalla on yliluonnollinen kyky. Laittamalla käden ihmisen sydämelle hän näkee avainhetkiä tämän tulevasta rakkauselämästä. Itse hän on menettänyt uskon rakkauteen, kunnes eräänä päivänä näkee yllättävän näyn. Ruotsi 2022

programme.title: Totte Svensson ja nuoruuden lähteen metsästys
programme.desc: Pyramidin alkuperästä voi kertoa vain Toten vanha ystävä, professori Omar. Totte ja lapset lentävät Egyptiin, missä Totte auttaa kaivauksissa. Mestarietsivä Totte Svensson saa yhteydenoton sisaruksilta, joiden vanhemmat on siepattu. Voiko Jeppe Kärppä olla taas vauhdissa? 2018

programme.title: Lajka
programme.desc: Rutin pomot kutsuvat valikoidun seurueen illalliselle. Rut huomaa, ettei ole enää kunniavieras. Cajsa tajuaa, ettei tästä työstä saa koskaan taukoa. Felicia Danielssonin ja Vera Herngrenin satiirisarja. Saamme seurata ystävysten Rutin ja Cajsan päivittäisiä haasteita influencer-maailmassa. Ruotsi 2022

programme.title: Agatha Christien Hjerson
programme.desc: Tunnettu näyttelijä ammutaan oikeilla luodeilla esityksen aikana. Hjersonilla on muuta tekemistä, joten Klara ottaa tutkinnan omiin käsiinsä. Moderni ruotsalainen arvoitusdekkari, jonka innoittajina olivat Agatha Christien kertomukset. Ainutlaatuinen murhatutkija Sven Hjerson (Johan Rheborg) muodostaa yllättävän etsiväkaksikon omapäisen tv-tuottajan (Hanna Alström) kanssa. Ruotsi 2021

programme.title: Fake Patient
programme.desc: Förhandling. Albin herää sairaalassa. Lääkäri kertoo pelätystä aivokasvaimesta, ja Albin joutuu hätäleikkaukseen. Felix tapaa Cissin ja kertoo tilanteesta. Albin asuu Uumajassa ja tekee lisätöitä valepotilaana sairaalassa odottaessaan näyttelijänuran käynnistymistä, kun hän saa tietää olevansa oikeasti sairas. Samaan aikaan Albin on aloittanut syrjähypyn agenttinsa Cissin kanssa. Ruotsi 2022

Felicia Danielssonin ja Vera Herngrenin satiirisarja. Saamme seurata ystävysten Rutin ja Cajsan päivittäisiä haasteita influencer-maailmassa. Ruotsi 2022

programme.title: Agatha Christien Hjerson
programme.desc: Tunnettu näyttelijä ammutaan oikeilla luodeilla esityksen aikana. Hjersonilla on muuta tekemistä, joten Klara ottaa tutkinnan omiin käsiinsä. Ainutlaatuinen murhatutkija Sven Hjerson (Johan Rheborg) muodostaa yllättävän etsiväkaksikon omapäisen tv-tuottajan (Hanna Alström) kanssa. Ruotsi 2021

programme.title: Knutby
programme.desc: Seurakunta on kääntynyt Annaa vastaan, ja hän yrittää epätoivoisesti saada Evan anteeksiannon. Sindre kärsii uuden vaimonsa ja Evan välissä. Tosipohjainen draamasarja paljon huomiota saaneesta Knutbyn tapauksesta, pääosissa Alba August ja Aliette Opheim. programme.desc: Kun Tommy lähentelee Mollyn oppilasta, Molly päättää lähteä Heddestasta. Mutta tehdäkö Tommysta rikosilmoitus vai vain jättää kaikki taakseen? Ruotsalainen draamasarja, joka perustuu löyhästi tunnetussa ratsastuskeskuksessa 1990-luvulla tapahtuneisiin järkyttäviin väärinkäytöksiin. programme.title: Totuus
programme.desc: Sovinto. Kausi päättyy. Iris ei luovuta, ja äkkiä Benjaminin tapauksen palaset osuvat kohdalleen. Kattis saa Irisin tajuamaan totuuden Christianista. Henkilökohtaisen tragedian leimaama Iris Broman on juuri jättänyt Tukholman ja aloittanut Malmön selvittämättömien juttujen ryhmän uutena pomona. Samana päivänä metsässä tehdään kaamea löytö. programme.title: The Hunting Party
programme.desc: Tohtori Ezekiel Malak. Sairaalapsykiatri toteutti jumaluuskompleksiaan tappamalla potilaita. Kuolemantuomion jälkeen hänet elvytettiin ja passitettiin Monttuun. Omakohtainen kokemus muutti hänen suhtautumistaan kuolemaan. Yhdysvallat 2025

programme.desc: Quentin Tarantinon yhdeksäs elokuva. Vuosi on 1969, ja viihdeteollisuus on peruuttamattoman muutoksen kourissa. Matkan varrella he kohtaavat joukon omalaatuisia hahmoja – myös kaupungin laidalla ranchilla asuvan hippiyhteisön.

programme.desc: Syntymäpäivämysteeri. Barbro aikoo kosia Muhammedia, mutta syntymäpäiväjuhla menee pieleen ja kihlasormukset katoavat. Lisäksi joku murtautuu kellariin ja kassakaappiin. programme.desc: Veli Pystyvä. Söderbergin poika tulee Sjölyckaniin. Hänestä tulee pian Berndtin suosikki ja Tomasin ja Klaran yhteinen vihollinen. Rille vaarantaa avioliittonsa. programme.title: Opiskelijakämppä
programme.desc: Saga lähtee Jennyn kanssa professori Paulan luo kysymään "varjotentistä". Kočí pyytää Sagaa mukaan Pariisiin. Opiskelijakämpässä hän tapaa karismaattiset klubittajat Sagan ja Oliverin, jotka jo ensimmäisenä iltana houkuttelevat Jennyn tekemään päätöksen, jolla on tuhoisat seuraukset... Ruotsi 2022

programme.title: Happy fucking Pride

Treffejä odottava pikkukaupungin poika Dilan, näennäisen itsevarma mutta satutettu huippumeklari Ari ja tämän juuri jätetty kaveri Nina navigoivat vauhdikkaiden kesäpäivien ja kuumien kesäöiden läpi. programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: (Ruth Légeret Case) Bloody Christmas next to the Leman lake
programme.sub-title: (Ruth Légeret Case) Bloody Christmas next to the Leman lake
programme.desc: On January 4, 2006, Ruth Légeret was found dead in the middle of a pool of blood at her luxurious property in Vevey, Switzerland. Next to her was the lifeless body of her friend, Marina Studer. Who could have killed these two simple and wealthy widows?

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: The Mathilde Croguenne Case
programme.desc: In the early hours of the morning, Mathilde Croguennec, 18, attending \"Teknival\" in Brittany, is found at the foot of a tree with her throat cut. Investigators face the task of finding the killer among the 43,000 participants of this festival

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: The Laurence Dromard Case
programme.desc: Sylvain Dromard finds the body of his wife Laurence lying in a pool of blood in the kitchen. The crime was particularly violent and the theory of a burglary that went wrong is soon excluded. But investigators don't understand who could want her dead.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Shot In the While Sleeping (Richard Alessandri Case)
programme.sub-title: Shot In the While Sleeping (Richard Alessandri Case)
programme.desc: On the night of July 16, 2000, the life of Edwige Alessandri changed forever. She made a frantic emergency call in the town of Carpentras. She recounted that some men burst into her room and shot her husband while he slept.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Murdered For a Fake Treasure - Troadec Case
programme.sub-title: Murdered For a Fake Treasure - Troadec Case
programme.desc: On March 28th 2013, the burnt body of Anne Barbot, 38 years old, is discovered in a forest of Maine-et-Loire.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: A Dire Deception (Laurence Maille Case)
programme.desc: On November 28, 2007, Laurence Maille disappeared. It was her partner, John Zablevski, who alerted the Vimy police in Pas-de-Calais. He explained that the young woman had left in the morning for a walk with their dog and never returned.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: The Christophe Lejard Case
programme.desc: The lifeless body of Christophe Lejard is found by his son just metres from their home. The man was shot in the head as he was getting into his car to go to work. An execution, which at first glance doesn't square with the profile of a quiet family man.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: The Mystery of Room 602 (Ve´ronique Pirotton Case)
programme.sub-title: The Mystery of Room 602 (Ve´ronique Pirotton Case)
programme.desc: On October 31, 2013, Belgian politician Bernard Ouessfal rushed down the six flights of a hotel in Ostend where he had met up with his wife, Véronique, the day before. He had found her unconscious in the bathroom with a mysterious plastic bag next to her

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Crime Scene Solvers: Honeymoon Killers (Van Beers Case)
programme.sub-title: Crime Scene Solvers: Honeymoon Killers (Van Beers Case)
programme.desc: Marc Van Beers, a 36-year old Brussels tax lawyer, dies in a road accident while on honeymoon. His wife Aurore is unharmed by the accident.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: The Priscillia Ciatti Case
programme.desc: The corpse of Priscillia Ciatti, 14, is discovered by the side of a field, a few hundred metres from her family home. The teenager has been stabbed sixty times with a knife and –an extra sordid detail – a devil mask is found next to her body.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Drost Notthoff Case
programme.desc: On September 11th 2011, in Èze, near Monaco, the owner of a luxury villa discovers the lifeless hanging body of his tenant, a rich German businessman.

programme.sub-title: The Little Martyrship of A10: The Inass Touloub Affair
programme.desc: On August 11, 1987, the Orléans police discover the bruised corpse of a 4-year-old child behind a guardrail on the A10 motorway.

programme.desc: On September 7, 2018, in Strasbourg, Sophie Le Tan is about to celebrate her 20th birthday with her family.

programme.desc: September 16 2005. The lifeless body of Audrey Jouannet, 24, is found hidden under the bed in her small apartment in Soisy-sur-Seine. It soon becomes apparent that the young woman has been tortured at length before being strangled.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Pinned by the Evidence
programme.desc: After a street fight takes the life of a national wrestling champion, police must determine if he was killed in cold blood or in self-defense.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Cries Unheard
programme.desc: A 19-year-old woman was found dead in her car; the scene had been staged to make murder appear to be suicide. During their investigation, police discovered the victim was involved in a love quadrangle, giving several people a motive to kill her.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Buried Treasure
programme.desc: A man disappears one year to the day after beginning an affair with his friend's wife. 15 years later, with the help of a metal detector, police find evidence that would prove what had happened and who was responsible.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Badge of Betrayal
programme.desc: When the body of a young woman is found under an isolated highway ramp, a unique fiber on the victim's clothing leads San Diego police straight to the most unlikely of killers.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Deadly Matrimony
programme.desc: A go-go dancer told her family she needed to get away for a while and then she simply disappeared. Investigators were suspicious, because she took neither her car nor her clothes. 20 years later, her family received a call that changed everything.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Muddy Waters
programme.desc: A Colorado hunter is the victim of a well-planned crime. Investigators suspect two weapons and two killers. But forensic evidence points them in a different direction — one much closer to home.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Point of Origin
programme.desc: In 1984, California firefighters battled ten arson fires in three weeks. When cigarettes and a scrap of paper connected the case to similar fires further north, the hunt was on for a dangerous pyromaniac.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Seeds for Doubt
programme.desc: In 2002, a small community in upstate New York was devastated when Patty Wlasiuk died in a truck accident. But burdock seed pods found in her hair and on her clothes indicated that this was no accident — it was cold-blooded murder.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Saving Face
programme.desc: When a woman disappeared without a trace, there were two possible explanations: kidnapping or murder. Careful investigation, a forensic artist and DNA profiling enabled police to find a single suspect, who was known to prey upon vulnerable women.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Northern Exposure
programme.desc: Alaskan hikers discover a body wrapped in sheets which were edged in orange stitching. Investigators find a tuft of red carpet fibers clinging to the sheet — threads of evidence which lead them straight to the killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Silk Stalkings
programme.desc: Prompted by news of a flight attendant's brutal murder, the son of a previous victim contacts police. Both murders have similar MOs, and biological evidence proves that these were serial killings.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Fishing for the Truth
programme.desc: A two-man shrimp boat sinks when a fast-moving, violent storm strikes the Louisiana coast. The captain drowns, but the deckhand is rescued fourteen hours later. The crewman is hailed as a hero — until the captain's body is discovered.

programme.title: Forensic Files: For Love or Money
programme.desc: When a wealthy real estate tycoon goes missing, it appears to be foul play. In his will, he leaves instructions in case he should die under violent circumstances — which were carried out after a hiker comes across his bullet-ridden skull.

programme.title: Forensic Files: South of the Border
programme.desc: The murder of an American tourist in a Mexican resort draws law enforcement resources on both sides of the border. At first glance, the motive appears to be robbery, but careful analysis of the forensic evidence points to something more sinister.

programme.title: Forensic Files: The Stake-Out
programme.desc: Police are led on a wild goose chase when the wife of a prominent banker is kidnapped. An entomologist's unexpected discovery leads to a new suspect — and the realization that ordinary office equipment can leave extraordinary clues.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Walking Terror
programme.desc: A neighbor watched as a man stabbed his wife, pushed her into the swimming pool and held her head under water. The husband, however, had no recollection of the crime. A jury would have to decide between evidence and the mysteries of the mind.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Marked for Life
programme.desc: It would take 46 years, handwriting analysis and new fingerprint technology to solve the 1957 murders of two California police officers.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Plastic Puzzle
programme.desc: A man riding a bicycle was fatally injured in what police believed to be a hit-and-run accident. Tiny clues found at the scene created a picture of the vehicle which struck him and led police to its driver.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Up in Smoke
programme.desc: When an elderly couple died in a suspicious house fire, their son became the prime suspect. Investigators turned to forensic science to determine if the fire had been set deliberately, or if it was an unfortunate accident.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Soiled Plan
programme.desc: Police instituted an intense search when the mother of two young children went missing. Twenty years after her body was found, new technology recontextualized old evidence and pointed directly to the killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Headquarters
programme.desc: When hunters reported finding a skull in a Texas canyon, police immediately began an investigation. With a forensic artist's reconstruction, police eventually learned the victim's identity. Now all they had to do was find her killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: One for the Road
programme.desc: A married couple decided to escape the cold of winter with a mini-vacation in Key West. The wife went missing and police searched every square inch of the island; they found nothing but a pair of sandals which might have belonged to her.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Army of Evidence
programme.desc: A mother of two young children was found dead in her bedroom. Her death was ruled a suicide — but when investigators learned she had almost died in a house fire three years earlier, they decided to take another look at the evidence.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Shear Luck
programme.desc: In 1991, when the wife of a serviceman was brutally murdered in the Philippines, investigators had to reassemble a tiny computer disk that had been cut to pieces in order to find the killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Tagging a Suspect
programme.desc: Bombings are difficult to solve because the perpetrator isn't usually at the scene and the evidence goes up in smoke. In this case, pieces of plastic the size of grains of sand hold the key to finding a murderer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Strong Impressions
programme.desc: The wife of an Air Force officer was found dead in her bed with a plastic laundry bag near her face. Further investigation proved that the scene had been staged. Her death wasn't an accident — it was cold-blooded murder.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Cereal Killer
programme.desc: When a fire destroyed most of a home and a young boy went missing, police organized the largest search in the history of their small town. First the boy's backpack was discovered five miles from home, then his body was found 50 miles away.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Crash Course
programme.desc: A highway patrolman was dispatched to what he thought would be a routine traffic accident — until he looked in the car. He had seen hundreds of accidents, but none with as much blood as this.

programme.title: Forensic Files: A Leg Up On Crime
programme.desc: The decomposed body of a young woman was discovered in a Bakersfield irrigation canal. If there was trace evidence, it had been washed away.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Tight-Fitting Genes
programme.desc: A behavioral profile caused the Baton Rouge Police Department to search for the wrong man. The real perpetrator may have eluded arrest, had it not been for a molecular biologist who painted DNA picture of the suspect.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Deadly Valentine
programme.desc: An obstetrician returned home from the hospital and found his wife on the bathroom floor. She was covered with blood and not breathing. He tried unsuccessfully to revive her, staining his clothes with her blood in the process.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Picture This
programme.desc: A Modesto, California teenager goes missing. With no signs of struggle in her home, police suspect she has simply run away — until her naked, bruised body is discovered in a ditch 20 miles away.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Oily in the Morning
programme.desc: When police recovered the submerged car of a missing man, they expected to find his body — but it wasn't there. The investigation that followed would uncover an obsession turned deadly.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Gold Rush
programme.desc: Emergency dispatch received a call from a man who said his girlfriend shot and killed herself. The autopsy revealed that the gunshot wound was not self-inflicted, and the evidence on her body would give police a golden opportunity to catch her killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Four on the Floor
programme.desc: When a Native American woman is brutally killed in the desert of New Mexico, her killers leave a crime scene rich in forensic evidence: tire tracks, shoe impressions and even the murder weapons.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Writer's Block
programme.desc: A brilliant young architect falls ill and dies just before she is to testify in a criminal trial. The autopsy reveals she'd been poisoned with arsenic. Investigators must determine who had a motive for murder.

programme.title: Forensic Files: A Clean Getaway
programme.desc: When a dry cleaner employee is raped and murdered in her store, police turn to forensic science for the answers they need.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Prints Among Thieves
programme.desc: The murder of an eccentric millionaire was not entirely unexpected; he flaunted his wealth and cared little for personal security. The evidence at the crime seemed to indicate robbery, but investigators wondered if there was something more.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Unholy Alliance
programme.desc: When a young woman disappeared, police feared she was the latest victim in a string of similar crimes. A pair of bloody gloves, unique tire tracks and ordinary pine needles provided investigators with some extraordinary clues.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Cop Out
programme.desc: When a college student is found dead, evidence suggests that he knew his killer. With just three hairs and some microscopic cells, police unravel a web of lies and find the motive for murder.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Summer Obsession
programme.desc: In an affluent suburb of Philadelphia, police were called to the scene of what appeared to be an accidental drowning. The investigation gradually focused on one suspect who had more than a million reasons to want the victim dead.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Elemental Clue
programme.desc: When two women from the same town were murdered in the same way, police feared a serial killer was on the loose. At first they thought the victims had nothing in common until they found tiny clues linking them to the same man.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Elemental Clue
programme.desc: When two women from the same town were murdered in the same way, police feared a serial killer was on the loose. At first they thought the victims had nothing in common until they found tiny clues linking them to the same man.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Moss, Not Grass
programme.desc: A young woman was found dead on a golf course in the Bahamas. The grass on that course was so distinctive, it had evidentiary value. The evidence led police to two suspects, each of whom blamed the other.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Moss, Not Grass
programme.desc: A young woman was found dead on a golf course in the Bahamas. The grass on that course was so distinctive, it had evidentiary value. The evidence led police to two suspects, each of whom blamed the other.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Material Witness
programme.desc: A teenager went missing after an evening of horseback riding. Her body was found a month later, three miles from her home. But the killer unknowingly left trace evidence behind.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Material Witness

programme.title: Forensic Files: Garden of Evil
programme.desc: When a popular disc jockey was found murdered in a community garden, police swung into action. A sniffer dog and a blood spatter expert led police to the killer, who had been much closer than they realized.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Sunday School Ambush
programme.desc: When a man is gunned down in his own garage, investigators use science to unravel a twisted tale of lust, greed and deception.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Penchant for Poison
programme.desc: Three seemingly unrelated deaths prove to be serial murders. The killer had been careful; he used poison which had no taste or odor. Fortunately for investigators, it also had a unique chemical signature.

programme.desc: I säsongens första avsnitt får vi bekanta oss med praktikanten Smilla som jobbar med Jörgen och Morgan. De får sig ett rejält gym-pass när en lastbil med hundratals kilon spån har vält utanför Umeå.

programme.title: Frusna vägar: Avsnitt 902
programme.desc: Dennis och Hogan får larm om två bilar som har krockat på riksväg 66 utanför Sälen. Stefan har fått in en lastbil som har vält på en åker, men att få upp den är lättare sagt än gjort.

programme.title: Frusna vägar: Avsnitt 903
programme.desc: Kent är ute och kör och snubblar nästan bokstavligt talat över en voltad bil. Dennis ska för första gången ensam ansvara för att dra upp en tung lastbil - även om pappa Hogan är med i bakgrunden.

programme.title: Frusna vägar: Avsnitt 904
programme.desc: Jörgen och Tony ska flytta ett hus till en skidbacke. Nya praktikanten Smilla är på plats för att hjälpa till och tar över. I dagens avsnitt får vi också bekanta oss med ett nytt ansikte - Gustav.

programme.title: Frusna vägar: Avsnitt 905
programme.desc: Stefan tar över Jörgen och Tonys hustransport. Men att få upp huset den sista sträckan är allt annat än enkelt, en brant och hal backe ställer till det.

programme.desc: Halkan har slagit till under natten och en lastbil har krockat med en personbil på tungt trafikerade E4:an utanför Umeå och Stefan måste jobba snabbt.

programme.desc: Utanför Umeå har en 30 ton tung grusbil vält och Gurra är på väg för att se till att den kommer upp på hjulen igen, ett långt ifrån lätt uppdrag. I Åre har en slambil fastnat i snön.

programme.desc: Stefan och Lill-Steffe tar sig an att få upp ett flak som är fullastat med tvätt från diket. Samtidigt ska Smilla dra upp en kvaddad bil som har kört av vägen mitt i en korsning.

programme.desc: En lastbil har kört av vägen efter en älgkollision i Sälen och Hogan måste rycka ut. Kent får hjälpa glassbilen som har fastnat i en backe i Åre. I Umeå är det snökaos och en bilist har kört fast.

programme.title: Frusna vägar: Avsnitt 1003

programme.title: Geordie Shore
programme.desc: Kyles bestman James och geordiegrabbarna kommer till Ko Samui för Kyles svensexa men Nathan och tjejerna har släppt loss i Bangkok. Holly dyker upp men Sophie känner sig nere och de andra spekulerar i om det är på grund av osämjan med Marnie.

programme.title: Geordie Shore
programme.desc: Efter en vild utekväll i Bangkok är Nathan och Chloe överens om att det är dags att dra till Ko Samui, där Holly är ensam tjej omgiven av sina ex. Familjen ser fram emot att återförenas men det blir jobbigt för Ricci när Chantelle kommer till huset.

programme.title: Geordie Shore
programme.desc: Kyle och James konfronterar Jay och Ricci om varför de inte kom till Kyles förlovningsfest. Jay blir överrumplad och det uppstår spänningar. Och gänget kan inte fatta att Marnie dyker upp på svensexan, speciellt inte Sophie... Superjobbigt!

programme.title: Geordie Shore
programme.desc: Marnie och Sophie rensar luften och det blir spänt. Det anländer fler personer till huset, och Ricci kan inte fatta att Chantelle har sagt att det som hände mellan dem inte betydde något - de kysstes ju bara när de var fulla.

programme.title: Geordie Shore
programme.desc: Ricci konfronterar Chantelle om att hon sagt att deras fling inte betydde någott. Det tar skruv! Hans goda avsikter slår också fel när han försöker förklara för James Leah att Jays fräcka kommentarer var oskyldiga... Chockerande!

programme.title: Geordie Shore
programme.desc: Elaka kommentarer i fyllan leder till att Chantelle och Abbie börjar bråka och Nathan och Chloe blir så pass osams att Chloe lämnar huset! Sprickor börjar uppstå inom familjen men mitt i kaoset friar James till Leah - kommer hon att säga "ja"?

programme.title: Geordie Shore
programme.desc: Kyle meddelar att det blir par-retreat till Koh Phangan men efter James förlovning börjar Sophie ifrågasätta sitt eget förhållande. Ricci inser att han vill att Chantelle ska bli hans flickvän, men känner hon samma sak?

programme.title: Geordie Shore
programme.desc: Ricci berättar för Abbie att han tyckte Leah betedde sig som en narcissist under deras bråk nyligen Abbie tar illa vid sig av hans ordval och de blir osams. Det blir spänt när Jordan and Casey möts ansikte mot ansikte för första gången på månader.

programme.title: Geordie Shore
programme.desc: Precis när det ser ut som att det ska skära sig mellan Casey och Jordan, räddar en plötslig ursäkt allt. Abbie bestämmer sig för att berätta för Leah om Riccis kontroversiella kommentar. Kan det här sabba den nyfunnna harmonin i huset?

programme.title: Geordie Shore
programme.desc: Det är geordiesarnas sista dag i Thailand och det finns fortfarande en spricka att laga. Nu ligger det på Sophie och Marnie att se till att familjen har det bra efter Chantelles och Abbies bråk. Dessutom dyker ett bekant ansikte upp.

programme.title: Geordie Shore: Big Birthday Battle: This Means War
programme.desc: Geordisarna är tillbaka på femårsdagen. Vi får se tårar när bekanta ansikten återvänder och Anna överraskar gänget med deras hittills största utmaning. Och vem får bära kronan till slut?

programme.title: Geordie Shore: Big Birthday Battle: Chloe Finds A Dinosaur
programme.desc: När ytterligare två ansikten dyker upp hettar tävlingen till. Vilka vinner: Aaron och Marnie eller Chloe och Marty? Gary visar sitt intresse för Charlotte, men kanske är inte alla glada för deras skull?

programme.title: Geordie Shore: Big Birthday Battle: First Date
programme.desc: Anna är rasande efter att ha sett några pinsamma klipp. Två tidigare medverkande kastas in, och Marty förstör stämningen. Gary gör allt för Charlotte när de dejtar.

programme.title: Geordie Shore: Big Birthday Battle: Holly's Dream Comes True
programme.desc: Hollys dröm blir verklighet när en person från förr dyker upp, men hur kommer resten av familjen att reagera? Charlottes team lovar to sabotera för Garys som hämnd, men lyckas de eller går planen i baklås?

programme.title: Geordie Shore: Big Birthday Battle: Charlotte Messes Up

programme.title: Vilterian: Burgare & Rygg

programme.title: Jakt Är Jakt: Drevjakt I Tyskland & Rough Shooting

programme.title: Jakt Är Jakt: Vi Testar Aimpoint Sikten

programme.desc: Nu är det Franks tur att glänsa. Han har blivit gästföreståndare på Hingebjergs folkhögskola. Men Frank får väldigt bråttom med att sätta sig själv i centrum.

programme.title: Klovn: Dr. Strangelove
programme.desc: Frank får lov att vara med i den förnäma filmklubben Les amis du Cinema. Men han kan inte följa klubbens regler, så det går inte särskilt bra för honom.

programme.title: Klovn: De Röda Byxorna
programme.desc: Revisor-Kurt övertalar Frank och Casper om att de ska investera i en lyxyacht. Det visar sig dock att det kanske inte var någon bra idé.

programme.title: Klovn: Namnplattan På Frederiksberg Allé
programme.desc: Äntligen har Frank lyckats bli nominerad till at få en teaterminnesplatta på Frederiksberg Allé. Han får Mia att hjälpa till med smöra på rätt ställen. Ännu en gång går det dock inte som Frank har förväntat sig.

programme.title: Klovn: Ett Porträtt Av En Tennisklubb
programme.desc: Frank använder alla knep för att vinna den årliga tennisturneringen. Som vanligt är det mest Frank själv som drabbas av sina lömska planer.

programme.title: Klovn: Alter Ego
programme.desc: Frank ska på återträffsfest på sin gymnasieskola. Han vill framstå som framgångsrik, inte minst inför Rikke, som var hans crush i gymnasiet.

programme.title: Klovn: Darwins Kontor
programme.desc: Frank känner sig särskilt utvald när han ska delta i ett forskningsprojekt, som Eske Willerslev lite av en tillfällighet bjudit in honom till. Frank visar sig snabbt ha haft mycket överdrivna förväntningar på vilken position han ska ha i projektet.

programme.title: Klovn: Politikerveckan
programme.desc: Frank solar sig i glansen av att han ska hålla ett klimatal under politikerveckan på Bornholm. Tyvärr stjäl Bjarne Corydon all uppmärksamhet efter en hjältemodig räddningsaktion. Frank gör sitt bästa för att få fokus flyttat från Corydon till sig själv.

programme.title: Klovn: Mias Fede Ferie
programme.desc: Frank, Casper, Mia och Fnug åker på parresa till Hornbæk. Mia vill helst mysa med Frank, Frank kämpar med att lyckas ladda sin elbil och Casper måste tyvärr medge att Fnug är ung och har många unga vänner i området.

programme.title: Klovn: Vänstertricket
programme.desc: Frank får bli medlem i CC:s herrklubb, där det talas om allvarliga känslor av existensiell karaktär. Mia har stora problem med klimakteriesymptom.

programme.title: Klovn: 5-årsdagen
programme.desc: Frank har glömt sin och Mias femårsdag och tänker gå på en monstertruck-show med Casper. Iben Hjejles mormor blir dödssjuk vilket skapar problem för Frank och Casper.

programme.title: Klovn: De Nya Danskarna
programme.desc: Mikkelsen jobbar med Casper om en återlansering av tv-serien Matador som tecknad film. Frank blir ovän med den pakistanske importen/exporten då han spelar hög musik.

programme.title: Klovn: Butlern
programme.desc: Michael Carøe har blivit pappa vilket firas med en killkväll och Frank har hyrt en strippa. Frank är missnöjd med att Mia alltid köper för lite bacon när hon handlar.

programme.title: Klovn: Dalai Lama
programme.desc: Casper och Frank är nära att få ett kontrakt med Palle Strøm. Palle får låna Franks kavaj för att känna sig cool på en dejt vilket får konsekvenser för dem båda.

programme.title: Klovn: Godfather Of Drugs
programme.desc: Franks läkare erbjuder Frank kokain. Mia, Iben och Bodil åker iväg på weekendresa och Casper bjuder in Mikael Carøe och Steen Jørgensen på killkväll.

programme.title: Klovn: Lyft Inte Upp Hunden
programme.desc: Frank stöter ihop med sin gamla ungdomskärlek i en sopcontainer på jakt efter ett guldur. Casper är chockad över att Frank har varit ihop med en som kan falla så djupt.

programme.title: Klovn: Fars Sista Önskan
programme.desc: Frank får en förhudsförträngning undersökt. Han insisterar på att få vara med nästa gång Mia ska på gynekologkontroll.

programme.title: Klovn: Storlek 44
programme.desc: Caspers kändisfotbollslag plågas av återbud inför en viktig kvalmatch. Frank tigger till sig en plats i laget, men måste själv fixa fotbollsskor.

programme.title: Klovn: Årstiderne
programme.desc: Mia och Frank kommer hem från sin semester och upptäcker att fruktlådor levererats - ruttna. Frank kämpar med reklamationer och ett bud som är dömd för misshandel.

programme.title: Klovn: Farväl Igen, Mamma!
programme.desc: Frank ska på herrlunch, men måste först flytta sin mammas urna till en annan plats på kyrkogården. Han förolämpar grävaren, vilket får konsekvenser.

programme.title: Klovn: Casa Tua
programme.desc: Mia vill att Frank ska kolla sin sperma vilket får följder. Casper tror inte att Frank skulle lägga ett graviditetstest med Mias kiss på köksbordet; vem är skyldig?

programme.title: Klovn: Bye Bye Bodil
programme.desc: Frank trivs inte i sällskap med hjärnskadade, men måste ställa upp på att hjälpa Pivert med att få in Bodil på ett vårdhem.

programme.title: Klovn: Don Ø-affären
programme.desc: Frank och Casper ska hämta speedway-biljetter hos Don Ø. Samtidigt gör Frank intryck på sin kvinnliga motspelare Mina i en mixed double-badmintonmatch med Mia.

programme.title: Klovn: Thors Öga
programme.desc: Frank berättar för Joan Ørting att han är omättlig i sängen. Joan tror inte att han är helt ärlig och uppmanar honom att göra något åt sina eventuella sexproblem.

programme.title: Klovn: Kunglig Hovnarr
programme.desc: Frank tappar bort sin Mont Blanc-penna vilket får irriterande följder för Casper på restaurang Spiseriet. Lars von Trier och Peter Ålbeck sätts samtidigt i knipa.

programme.title: Klovn: It's A Jungle Down There
programme.desc: Iben och Mia har börjat på en onanikurs för kvinnor hos Pernille Højmark. Casper och Frank ger ett intryck av att de stöttar dem, men de tittar lite väl närgånget.

programme.title: Klovn: Ambassadören
programme.desc: Frank och Mia ska köpa ny sportbil. Lars Hjortshøj har utnämnts till HC Andersen-ambassadör och får problem med sin au pair.

programme.desc: Franks penis spelar en central roll på Carøes barndop. Iben bär barnet, Mia är förfärad och Carøes fru Susan vill inte ha något som helst med Franks doptårta att göra.

programme.title: Klovn: Irma-flickan
programme.desc: Frank får för lite sex och Stig Rossens tjejkompis vill hjälpa till. Casper är avundsjuk och Frank hamnar i en affär där han tittar närgånget på expeditens rumpa.

programme.title: Lyxfällan Danmark: Avsnitt 2602

programme.title: Lyxfällan Danmark

programme.title: Lyxfällan Danmark: Avsnitt 2506
