programme.title: Lyxfällan Norge: Avsnitt 2501
programme.desc: Ørjan har köpt och sålt över 100 bilar under 13 års tid och hans tomt är full av olika fordon. Han har en bra lön, men spenderar desto mer, och när kontot ekar tomt handlas det på kredit.

programme.desc: Joc överväger att dra sig ur Spice album så att han inte äventyrar sitt äktenskap. Amy tar Bambis rester.

programme.title: Caught In The Act: Unfaithful
programme.desc: Tami och hennes expertteam letar upp sanningarna som de bedragna behöver för att avgöra framtiden för förhållandena.

programme.title: Ghosted: Love Gone Missing: Andi & Dade
programme.desc: Naimah och Maher var klassens clowner och blev bästa kompisar direkt. När Naimah tog värvning blev det allt svårare att hålla vänskapen vid liv.

programme.title: Caught In The Act: Unfaithful: Har hon en annan lägenhet?
programme.desc: I över fyra år har Gierra dejtat Shay som är klubbpromotor. Gierra vill bilda familj med sin partner.

programme.title: Geordie Shore: Var det nån som beställde Gary Beadle?
programme.desc: Ricci pratar med Kyle om de sjudande spänningarna och Sophie och Jordan anländer till villan och ger gänget en injektion av positiv energi.

programme.title: The Challenge: All Stars: Olycksaliga rivaler
programme.desc: De tre rivaliserande lagen som saknar en stjärna överväger mer drastiska åtgärder för att få tag på en.

programme.title: Ridiculousness: Sterling och Nina Agdal LXIV
programme.desc: I detta avsnitt av Ridiculousness försöker Rob Dyrdek, Steelo Brim och Nina Agdal lägga sig bekvämt i 'Hängmattehelvete'.

programme.title: Ridiculousness: Sterling och Nina Agdal LXV

programme.title: Ridiculousness: Sterling och Nina Agdal LXVI
programme.desc: I detta avsnitt av Ridiculousness beger sig Rob, Steelo och Nina Agdal ut på planen för att bli 'Picklebollad'.

programme.desc: Låtar som framförs: "Name", "Slide", "Here is Gone", "Iris", "Black Balloon", "Big Machine", What a Scene", "Broadway", "Lucky Star".

programme.title: Scream 5
programme.desc: 25 vuotta sen jälkeen, kun Woodsboron kaupunkia järkytti sarja raakoja murhia, se tapahtuu taas. Menneisyyden salaisuudet paljastuvat, kun tekijä riehuu viidennen kerran. Nyt vain pari eloonjäänyttä voi pysäyttää murhaajan Ghostface-maskin takana.

programme.title: Together
programme.desc: Vuosia yhdessä olleet Tim ja Millie ovat elämänsä käännekohdassa. Kun he muuttavat suurkaupungista maalle uuden alun toivossa, heillä on vain toisensa. Mutta pinnan alla kytevät jännitteet, ja pian he kohtaavat karmivan yliluonnollisen voiman, joka uhkaa tuhota heidän elämänsä, rakkautensa – ja koko olemassaolonsa. Australialaisen body horror -kauhuelokuvan tähtinä ovat Dave Franco ja Alison Brie.

programme.title: Beck: Varjoissa
programme.desc: Tukholman lähiössä tapahtuu kuolettava ampuminen, ja veriteosta epäillään väkivaltaista jengiä. Epäillyt löytyvät pian sidottuina rikospaikan läheltä, ja kaiken taustalla vaikuttaa olevan mystinen hahmo, jolla on hämäriä motiiveja. Beckin tiimi lähtee rajat ylittävään operaatioon löytääkseen jengin johtajan ja selvittääkseen, kuka tuo tuntematon toimija on. Beck: Varjoissa on sarjan 54. elokuva.

programme.title: On Set
programme.desc: Viihdeohjelma On Set vie Hollywoodin tähtitehtaan kulissien taakse. 2020

programme.title: Star File
programme.desc: Emma Thompson. Viihdeohjelma, jonka jokaisessa osassa piirretään muotokuva jostakin Hollywood-tähdestä, alkutaipaleelta uran huipuille ja suvantoihin. 2020

programme.title: Star File

programme.title: Star File

programme.title: Star File

programme.title: Veijarikoplan suurin keikka
programme.desc: Herman Melvin (Stellan Skarsgård) lyöttäytyy yhteen Veijarikoplan kanssa. Tällä kertaa kopla ryöstää setelipainon ja joutuu hankaluuksiin Puolassa.

programme.title: Kertausharjoitukset
programme.desc: Vanhojen kaverusten kertausharjoitukset menevät aivan läskiksi, kun osanottajat ovat kiinnostuneempia naisten jahtaamisesta, hotellilla tanssimisesta sekä ruoasta ja juomasta. Janne "Loffe" Carlsson on huippukunnossa klassikkokomediassa.

programme.title: Hammarskjöld
programme.desc: Vuonna 1961 kylmän sodan aikaan Dag Hammarskjöldillä on vielä vuosi jäljellä tehtävässään YK:n pääsihteerinä. Tämän jälkeen hän aikoo muuttaa taloonsa Österleniin ja nauttia odottamastaan vapaudesta. Kylmä sota kuitenkin jatkuu, yhtenä keskipisteenään Kongon kriisi. Hammarskjöld ottaa tehtäväkseen rauhan välittämisen maahan, tehtävän jota moni pitää mahdottomana.

programme.title: The Last Letter from Your Lover
programme.desc: Romanttinen draama Jojo Moyesin bestsellerin pohjalta kahdesta eri aikakausien naisesta, jotka jäävät arvoituksellisten rakkauskirjeiden pauloihin.

programme.title: Bert pilaa kaiken
programme.desc: Parhaat ystävät Bert ja Åke aloittavat TET-viikot. Samalla tapahtuu jotain mullistavaa: Åke rakastuu ensimmäistä kertaa elämässään Mollyyn, joka on TET-harjoittelussa yhdessä Bertin kanssa. Mutta myös Bert on ihastunut samaan tyttöön ja Mollykin tuntuu pitävän hänestä! Pian ongelmat kasaantuvat melkoiseksi sekasotkuksi ja Bert on vaarassa menettää sekä parhaan ystävänsä että suuren rakkautensa.

programme.title: Under solen
programme.desc: On vuosi 1956. Pienellä ruotsalaistilalla asuu maanviljelijä Olof. Eräänä päivänä hän laittaa lehteen ilmoituksen: "Yksinäinen maanviljelijä, 39, etsii nuorta naista taloudenhoitajaksi. Toiveena valokuva." Pian kaupungista saapuu Ellen.

programme.title: Kunnian miehiä
programme.desc: Neljä Oscar-ehdokkuutta saanut, Rob Reinerin ohjaama draama, pääosissa Jack Nicholson, Tom Cruise ja Demi Moore.

programme.title: One chance
programme.desc: Ujo kännykkämyyjä Paul Potts löi koko Iso-Britannian – ja maailman – ällikällä osallistuttuaan brittiläiseen kykykilpailuun ja osoitettuaan olevansa huikea oopperalaulaja. Tosipohjaisessa elokuvassa seurataan koko ikänsä kiusattua miestä, josta tuli supertähti. Pääosaa esittää näyttelijä ja talk show -juontaja James Corden, ja Julie Waters (Billy Elliot) nähdään poikaansa alati tukevana äitinä.

programme.title: Borg/McEnroe
programme.desc: Elokuvassa Björn Borgin matkasta Södertäljestä maailman eliittikentille kuvataan hänen suurinta kamppailuaan vuonna 1980 Borgin kohdatessa amerikkalaisen superlahjakkuuden John McEnroen. Heidän kilpailunsa tempasi mukaan koko tennismaailman.

programme.title: Beck: Kuolema Samarrassa
programme.desc: Yksi ehdokkaista Nobelin rauhanpalkinnon saajaksi murhataan raa'asti veitsellä Tukholmassa. Beck-ryhmä epäilee pian, että kyse on poliittisesta murhasta. Tutkintaa mutkistaa Alexin läheinen suhde yhteen päätodistajaan. Järjestyksessään 41. Beck-elokuva.

programme.title: Non-Stop
programme.desc: Henkeäsalpaava toimintatrilleri alkoholisoituneesta poliisista (Liam Neeson), jonka on yksin hoidettava lentokonekaappaus.

programme.title: Non-Stop
programme.desc: Henkeäsalpaava toimintatrilleri alkoholisoituneesta poliisista (Liam Neeson), jonka on yksin hoidettava lentokonekaappaus.

programme.title: Tiedän mitä teit viime kesänä
programme.desc: Eräänä kesäyönä joukko nuoria ajaa vahingossa autollaan kalastajan päälle. Kun he eivät saa häntä elvytettyä, he luulevat tämän kuolleen ja heittävät paniikissa ruumiin mereen. Seuraavana kesänä he alkavat saada outoja kirjeitä, joissa lukee: ”Tiedän, mitä teit viime kesänä.” Pian heitä vainoaa mies sadetakissa ja terävä koukku kädessään. Klassinen 90‑luvun kauhuelokuva.

programme.title: Cujo – kauhun silmät
programme.desc: Vic ja Donna Trenton sekä heidän poikansa Tad lähtevät korjauttamaan autoaan mekaanikko Joe Cambersin luo, jossa he kohtaavat kiltin bernhardinkoira Cujon. Cujo on kuitenkin saanut kaniinin pesäkololla seikkailtuaan lepakonpureman ja sen seurauksena raivotaudin. Kun Donna ja Tad palaavat korjaamolle, Cujo on jo muuttunut – hirvittävällä tavalla. Stephen Kingin romaaniin perustuva kauhuelokuva.

programme.title: Hustlers - Korkojen kera
programme.desc: Kiitetty rikosdraama strippareista Ramona (Jennifer Lopez) ja Destiny (Constance Wu), joiden on vaikeaa pitää elämänsä kasassa. Yhdessä muutamien kollegojensa kanssa he päättävät alkaa huijaamaan rahaa hämäräperäisiltä Wall Street -asiakkailtaan.

programme.desc: Miten nykymaailmassa oikein löytää rakkauden? Tässä romanttisessa komediassa tapaamme Lontoossa lapsuudenystävät Zoen ja Kazin, joiden tapa lähestyä ihmissuhteita on erilainen.

programme.title: Niin kuin taivaassa
programme.desc: Menestynyt kuoronjohtaja lopettaa uransa ja vetäytyy lapsuudenmaisemiinsa Norlantiin. Siellä harjoittelee joka torstai pieni kirkkokuoro, jonka jäsenten pyyntöihin hänen on vaikeaa vastata kieltävästi. Siitä lähtien mikään ei ole ennallaan.

programme.title: Micke & Veronika

programme.title: Paradise Hotel, säsong 18

programme.title: Paradise Hotel, säsong 18

programme.title: Paradise Hotel, säsong 18

programme.title: Paradise Hotel, säsong 18

programme.title: Paradise Hotel, säsong 18
programme.desc: Chocken och vreden är fortsatt stor efter det oväntade valet på parceremonin. Hotellet förvandlas till en brasiliansk karneval där fotbollsstjärnorna ska slåss om karnevalens drottning.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel, säsong 18
programme.desc: En tröstande gest blir missförstådd och blossar istället upp till en gigantisk konflikt. Glädjande nog är en latino-lover på väg för att charma tjejerna, men glädjen riskerar att bli kortvarig.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel, säsong 18
programme.desc: Sorgen efter vaxningsceremonin ligger som ett täcke över hotellet och nya planer behöver sättas i verket för att överleva veckan. Somliga ger sig hän åt hot medan andra satsar på hångel och nakenbad.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel, säsong 18
programme.desc: Flera planer är igång samtidigt inför kvällens Parceremoni där utgången helt beror på vilken plan som faktiskt kommer ske. Ett totalt svek, en oväntad revansch och en hemlig bekännelse väntar.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel, säsong 18
programme.desc: Hotellet har förvandlats till ett fängelse och det dröjer inte länge förrän ett värdefullt föremål försvinner spårlöst. De intagna får sig en chock när det visar sig att fler åtalade är på väg.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel, säsong 18
programme.desc: Nervositeten är stor kring rättegången, där ett erkännande innebär en säker väg mot finalveckan medan partnern tvingas checka ut. Fångarna måste också svara på vem som förtjänar att stanna och inte.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel, säsong 18

programme.title: Paradise Hotel, säsong 18
programme.desc: Domarna ska besluta vem som hållit det bästa försvarstalet och därmed blir immun. Kampen om att få sin drömpartner till finalveckan har börjat, men är det hjärtat eller hjärnan som kommer vinna?

programme.title: Paradise Hotel, säsong 18

programme.title: Paradise Hotel, säsong 18

programme.title: IFISH: Australian Salmon - Port Lincoln, SA
programme.desc: Local knowledge is always best, so when young Archie from Port Lincoln told me we were gonna smash some BIG Australian Salmon off the beach - I knew I was in for one hell of a day!

programme.title: IFISH: Spanish Mackerel - Namotu Island, Fiji
programme.desc: The apple doesn't fall far from the tree. Down rigging big live baits, deep dropping for monsters of the deep and popping for those massive surface strikes - what more could Jet and I ask for!

programme.title: IFISH: Black Bream - Bemm River, VIC
programme.desc: Traditionally bream fishing is a game of bait and wait... well not if Franks around! Local East Gippsland guru, Frank Milito, gives PW a lesson in using vibes for BIG Bemm River bream, that you really must see!

programme.title: IFISH: Sailfish - Darwin, NT
programme.desc: When Paul hears the word "Darwin", two things come to mind - Barra and Crocs! So when PW got invited to fish for sailfish, in 20m of water, he couldn't say no! Get out your note pad and pen, because you're about to learn how you can do it all yourself!

programme.title: IFISH: Barramundi, Horizontal Falls, WA
programme.desc: There is only one thing better than waking up in the remote pristine wilderness of the Kimberley - and that's fishing it! Join the Worsteling tribe as they navigate their way through dense mangrove systems in search of the mighty BARRAMUNDI!

programme.title: IFISH: Yellowtail Kingfish, Jervis Bay, NSW
programme.desc: "Catch the fresh bait, get the BIG fish!" Join the team for a step by step lesson in down rigging fresh baits for big angry Kings!

programme.title: Icelandic Tails: Episode 1
programme.desc: Robson Green, the actor and host of Extreme Fishing TV series is our guest. He has never fished for Icelandic salmon. We travel to the remote pools of Kjarrá by helicopter and fish pools that are untouched the whole summer.

programme.title: Icelandic Tails: Episode 2
programme.desc: Charles and Alex Jardine travel to the highlands of Iceland looking for monster arctic char. Charles Jardine is a respected artist who specializes in painting fish and fisherman. The river they fish is a gin clear river, home to some huge trout.

programme.title: Icelandic Tails: Episode 3
programme.desc: Tiggy Pettifer, a passionate angler, is visiting Iceland. She is a well known personality in the UK being a former employee of the royal family. Tiggy gos to lake Thingvallavatn and looks for the Ice age brown trout that the lake is famous for.

programme.title: Icelandic Tails: Episode 4
programme.desc: The 93 year old Lilla Rowcliffe is coming to Iceland for the 30th time. Fishing the same river. Big Laxá. She brings along her grandson and great grandson that is 11 years old. Lilla has had an astonishing live and shares a bit of that live with us.

programme.title: Icelandic Tails: Episode 5
programme.desc: Mother and daughter fish both river Vídidalsá and river Midfjardará. The mother Joanna Gibson is taken along with her daughter Marina Gibson who is a highly skilled fisherman and runs her own very successful fly fishing school in Europe.

programme.title: Icelandic Tails: Episode 6
programme.desc: Robson Green is back with a friend and a colleague. Actor James Murray joins him for an adventure in Iceland. Fishing Laxá in Asum, or just Asum the two give a great performance in this famous river. Competition is on.

programme.title: Pure Fly NZ: Lake Otamangakau
programme.desc: Andrew Harding and Matt Hince team up to visit a huge man-made lake - one of New Zealand's most famous trophy trout waters - in the country's North Island: Lake Otamangakau.

programme.title: Pure Fly NZ: Southland Smelters
programme.desc: New Zealand's Southland's four major rivers are famous as brown trout fisheries, especially in the upper and middle sections, but in this episode Anto Hall and Mike Wilkinson are heading to the estuaries, to fish the annual smelt run.

programme.title: Pure Fly NZ: Golden Bay Kingfish
programme.desc: Discovering new waters to fish is among the pinnacles of the fly fishing experience, and this saltwater flats fishery, Golden Bay, is just such a gem. Kingfish have a unique relationship with short-tailed stingrays, which they use as mobile cover.

programme.title: Pure Fly NZ: Backcountry Kaimanawas
programme.desc: This episode of Pure Fly NZ sees a helicopter ride take anglers Cory Scott and Chris Charland deep into the the mountains to target New Zealand's famous trophy trout, but will an approaching weather-bomb cause them a headache.

programme.title: Pure Fly NZ: Tauranga Taupo
programme.desc: Lake Taupo was formed in the caldera caused by an enormous volcanic explosion. The Tauranga is one of the few tributaries that the lake's legendary rainbow trout use to spawn.

programme.title: Pure Fly NZ: Autumn Chromers
programme.desc: The South Island's Otago Lakes District is the location for remarkable autumn trout fishing brought about by the fish leaving the lakes and heading upstream to spawn.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Landing on Mars
programme.desc: Mars sparks our curiosity like no other planet because it is so reachable. Despite having landed there, most of the information we gather is still done by instruments in the planet's orbit.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: The Big Bang
programme.desc: Throughout history, our nightly view of the universe has fueled our collective imagination. When it comes to the Big Bang, not even the most creative work of imagination can rival what science has revealed about the birth of the universe.

programme.title: Inside Outer Space: Episode 1: The Solar System
programme.desc: This is a series packed with space stories and information about our universe covering what we can see, how we can live in space and what science tells us about the past and the future as we journey inside out of space.

programme.title: Inside Outer Space: Episode 7: The Milky Way
programme.desc: Come with us as we explore and unravel the mysteries of what lies beyond our planet Earth. This is a series packed with space stories and information about our universe covering what we can see.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: The Sun
programme.desc: The sun bathes our planet in warmth and light. It powers the machinery of nature, our weather, and it encourages and sustains life on land and at sea. We study it closely, and it can reveal the secrets of all other stars.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Orbit
programme.desc: Chances are, you are watching this program by satellite, one way or the other. Every day we use these wonders of human design, from communication and weather observation, to GPS and recourse management.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Sling Shot
programme.desc: Soviet Luna 3 was the first to use gravity to change course to photograph the dark side of the Moon. NASA Mariner 10 used the technique to swing by Venus to target Mercury. The gravity sling shot maneuver has become a standard for space navigation.

programme.title: Inside Outer Space: Episode 3: Asteroids
programme.desc: Come with us as we explore and unravel the mysteries of what lies beyond our planet Earth. This is a series packed with space stories and information about our universe covering what we can see.

programme.title: Inside Outer Space: Episode 6: Fermi paradox
programme.desc: Come with us as we explore and unravel the mysteries of what lies beyond our planet Earth. This is a series packed with space stories and information about our universe covering what we can see.

programme.title: How to Colonize the Stars: The Challenge of Interstellar Flight
programme.desc: Leading physicists and engineers in the field of interstellar travel discuss some of the deep issues we face when considering the problem of sending spacecraft to other stars. Will mankind ever truly become a space fairing civilization?

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Hidden Havens: Icy Moons / Icy Gems: Frozen Moons
programme.sub-title: Hidden Havens: Icy Moons / Icy Gems: Frozen Moons
programme.desc: See the sun, moon, planets, and galaxies through the eyes of intrepid machines that are blazing a trail across the solar system. A gateway to bold adventures, these cameras are delivering spectacular new cosmic vistas.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Fermi Paradox
programme.desc: The Fermi Paradox asks the ultimate question: Given a few reasonable assumptions about the chance of life arising elsewhere in the universe and the distance between the stars, why has an alien civilization not presented itself?

programme.title: Inside Outer Space: Episode 2: Moons
programme.desc: Come with us as we explore and unravel the mysteries of what lies beyond our planet Earth. This is a series packed with space stories and information about our universe covering what we can see.

programme.desc: Come with us as we explore and unravel the mysteries of what lies beyond our planet Earth. This is a series packed with space stories and information about our universe covering what we can see.

programme.title: One Small Step: Neil Armstrong
programme.desc: Neil Armstrong has stamped his place in History by becoming the first person to walk on the moon.

programme.title: Trajectory - Milestones in Space Exploration: Project Gemini Docking, Mars Curiousity & Satellite Swarms
programme.sub-title: Project Gemini Docking, Mars Curiousity & Satellite Swarms
programme.desc: Project Gemini: Docking and EVA - In the final phase of the Gemini program NASA struggles with docking and spacewalks. Curiosity Roving Mars - On the surface of Mars the Curiosity rover is changing the way we think about the red planet.

programme.title: Earthrise: The First Lunar Voyage: Earthrise: The First Lunar Voyage
programme.desc: Interviews with Apollo 8 astronauts, their wives, mission control staff, and journalists give true insider's perspective to the space race of the late 1960's.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Gravity
programme.desc: Gravity keeps us on the ground and the planets in their orbits, yet we only notice it when it's not there. In space we cheat gravity; falling just as fast but missing the ground. Now this fundamental universal force is slowly giving up its secrets.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: The Planet Makers
programme.desc: From the beginnings of our solar system 4.5 billions years ago, there remain many clues to reveal its evolution. Remnant debris, asteroids, and comets are what's left of the building blocks to our celestial neighborhood.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Windows to Other Worlds / Fountain of Creation
programme.sub-title: Windows to Other Worlds / Fountain of Creation
programme.desc: See the sun, moon, planets, and galaxies through the eyes of intrepid machines that are blazing a trail across the solar system. A gateway to bold adventures, these cameras are delivering spectacular new cosmic vistas.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Virtual Universe
programme.desc: Our understanding of the cosmos is limited by the amount of time we have to see it. Fortunately, computer simulations can help us see how galaxies interact over millions of years, and even how dark matter structures the universe.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Water Worlds
programme.desc: The key ingredient to life in the universe is water. Until recently we thought Earth was the only place in the solar system to have any water at all. Now that probes are peering around nearby worlds we are finding that is just not the case.

programme.title: Trajectory - Milestones in Space Exploration: Project Gemini Advances, Cassini at Saturn & More About Mars
programme.sub-title: Project Gemini Advances, Cassini at Saturn & More About Mars
programme.desc: Project Gemini Advances - NASA refines the techniques needed for rendezvous. Cassini at Saturn - In the Cassini probe's final years of activity, its handlers are asking it to do more complex and risky assignments.

programme.sub-title: Project Gemini, Venus Express, EMU & Deep Space Communication
programme.desc: Project Gemini Commences - Did Gemini give the US a lead in the space race? Venus Express - The last days of ESA's Venus probe. EMU - NASA's Extravehicular Mobility Unit. Deep Space Communications - ESA's worldwide network of giant dishes.

programme.title: Mord i Paradiset

programme.title: Skönhetsfällan Danmark: Avsnitt 302
programme.desc: Två av Danmarks bästa plastikkirurger hjälper människor som råkat ut för misslyckade ingrepp. Vi möter Isabella, en 18-åring vars bröstförstoring blev en total katastrof.

programme.title: Skönhetsfällan Danmark: Avsnitt 803
programme.desc: Natasha är en före detta modell. År 2013 fick hon implantaten i sina silikonbröst utbytta, men operationen gick inte som planerat och därför har hon nu två mycket olika bröst.

programme.title: Skönhetsfällan Danmark: Avsnitt 806
programme.desc: Tinas mardröm började 2015 när hon fick en tumör på näsan som fortsatte att växa. Hon måste genomgå strålbehandling för att få bort den, men tumören lämnar också ett hål som måste stängas.

programme.title: Skönhetsfällan Danmark: Avsnitt 303
programme.desc: Vi möter Doris som har varit med om en våldsam busskrasch. Idag kämpar hon med extrema konsekvenser av den plastikoperation som skulle rädda hennes utseende efter olyckan.

programme.title: Skönhetsfällan Danmark: Avsnitt 101
programme.desc: Två av Danmarks toppkirurger möter offer för misslyckad plastikkirurgi. Bland andra träffar vi Mille, som jagar drömmen om perfektion, och Joan, som tycker att hon har förlorat sin kvinnlighet.

programme.title: Skönhetsfällan Danmark: Avsnitt 103
programme.desc: Ivanas liv hängde på en skör tråd under hennes plastikoperation som kostade ett astronomiskt belopp. Lotte döljer sin sönderopererade mage bakom tatueringar. Kan kirurgerna hjälpa dem

programme.title: Skönhetsfällan Danmark: Avsnitt 703
programme.desc: Den före detta burleskdansösen Grethe fick båda sina bröst bortopererade 2011 som en del av sin behandling för bröstcancer.

programme.title: Skönhetsfällan Danmark: Avsnitt 312
programme.desc: Vi möter Angelina gjort bröstkirurgi 11 gånger. I sökandet efter drömbrösten reser hon till Miami, där hon lägger in 1500 ml i brösten och det slutar med att de blir så stora att de spricker.

programme.title: Skönhetsfällan Danmark: Avsnitt 308
programme.desc: I det här avsnittet möter vi Britt, som är upprörd både över utseendet på hennes bröst och den smärta hon fått efter en mastektomi och drömmer om ett bröllop med fina bröst och utan smärta.

programme.title: Skönhetsfällan Danmark: Avsnitt 306
programme.desc: Vi möter Jeanette som känner sig som en försökskanin efter en rad misslyckade operationer.

programme.title: Skönhetsfällan Danmark: Avsnitt 705
programme.desc: Som 21-åring drömmer Simone om runda och fylliga bröst. Hon genomgår en bröstförstoring som slutar med en inflammation varpå hon gör flera omoperationer, innan hon säger stopp till kirurgen.

programme.title: Skönhetsfällan Danmark: Avsnitt 406
programme.desc: I det här avsnittet möter vi Anita som vaknade upp med större bröst än vad hon hade kommit överens om med kirurgen och som nu känner sig som en miniversion av Linse Kessler.

programme.title: Skönhetsfällan Danmark: Avsnitt 102
programme.desc: Två av landets bästa kirurger är redo att hjälpa människor som fått betala ett högt pris för sin jakt efter ungdom och skönhet. Ta reda på om dessa misslyckade operationer kan korrigeras.

programme.title: Skönhetsfällan Danmark: Avsnitt 404
programme.desc: Vi möter Maria, som efter en bröstförstoring fick ett hål ända upp till implantatet, och Casper, som hela sitt liv har blivit mobbad på grund av sin näsa.

programme.title: Skönhetsfällan Danmark: Avsnitt 901
programme.desc: Som tonåring var Melissa ledsen över sin killiga kropp och beslutade sig för att genomgå tre bröstförstoringsoperationer. Men nu är hon fast i ett smärthelvete som är på väg att göra henne morfinberoende.

programme.title: Skönhetsfällan Danmark: Avsnitt 704
programme.desc: Iben drömmer om att vinna en Body Fitness-tävling för nybörjare, men hon känner att hennes bröst är i vägen. Oavsett hur mycket hon arbetar på sin kropp kan hon inte träna sina bröst.

programme.title: Skönhetsfällan Danmark: Avsnitt 906
programme.desc: Mia tycker att hon efter flera operationer ser ut som någon med fyra bröst. Alice mage blir allt större och större och hon kämpar med magsyra, smärta och oönskad gråt. Kan läkarna hjälpa dem?

programme.title: Skönhetsfällan Danmark: Avsnitt 701
programme.desc: Efter en våldsam olycka där Dan faller från ett tak och landar på ansiktet genomgår han två operationer för att laga sin näsa.

programme.title: Skönhetsfällan Danmark: Avsnitt 905
programme.desc: Melanie och Monas operationer hindrar dem från att vara intima med sin respektive partner. Karina fick uppgradera sina bröst till Barbiebröst, och nu sipprar det ut var från bröstvårtorna.

programme.title: Skönhetsfällan Danmark: Avsnitt 904
programme.desc: Jeannes bröst hindrar henne från att leva ett normalt liv. Gitte skäms för sina ben och lägger ner mycket tid och energi på att dölja dem.

programme.title: Skönhetsfällan Danmark: Avsnitt 105
programme.desc: Sabine hittade ett erbjudande på nätet, men fick betala dyrt för sin rabatterade plastikoperation. Helle har under årens lopp uthärdat sådan smärta att hon inte ens kan arbeta.

programme.desc: För första gången i programmets historia har både mor och dotter hamnat i en plastikkirurgi-mardröm. Nu söker de tillsammans hjälp.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)
programme.desc: Captain Tony Nelson, an astronaut, is engaged to Melissa Stone, daughter of General Wingard Stone, his commanding officer. Tony is rocketed into space in a capsule which lands is the Pacific. He reaches a small island. There he releases Jeannie, a beautiful blonde, who can perform magic with a blink of her eyes, from a bottle is which she has been imprisoned for ages. Jeannie tells Tony she is his slave forever. Worried about Jeannie's effect on Melissa and his career, Tony tries to leave Jeannie behind on the island, but she smuggles herself aboard the rescue plan. Questioned about his reactions in space by the base psychiatrist, Dr. Alfred Bellows, Tony tells about his meeting with Jeannie. Feeling that Tony is suffering from hallucinations, Bellows calls General Stone.Jeannie appears at Tony's home. Tony tries frantically to keep General Stone, Melissa, Doctor Bellows and Captain Roger Henley, a fellow astronaut, from seeing Jeannie. His problems reach a climax when Jeannie produces a harem of dancing girls to perform for Tony. After Tony works his way out of that, Melissa and her father leave, feeling a vacation, combined with a honeymoon, will solve Tony's problems. Tony orders Jeannie to leave no doubt that she is determined to be a part of Tony's life for a long time.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)
programme.desc: Jeannie blinks Tony to ancient Persia to defend her honor while Jeannie announces to her parents that this is the man she plans to marry.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)
programme.sub-title: Guess What Happened On The Way To The Moon
programme.desc: To test man's ability to survive on the moon, Captain Anthony (Tony) Nelson, and his fellow astronaut, Captain Roger Healey, are ordered to spend a week, in Furnace Canyon, Nevada, 100 degrees in the daytime, 10 below freezing at night. Except for water, they are to live off the land. Jeannie hides in Tony's canteen. Tony tries to make Jeannie understand that she is destroying the value of the mission, but she sticks with him. While Roger barely survives, Tony has every luxury, from food and a harem tent, to a final ride on a camel to finish the journey.Dr. Bellows is baffled to find that while Roger has lost twelve pounds, Tony has gained five. When Tony tries to explain Jeannie's presence, Dr. Bellows concludes that he has the imagina-tion men need to survive on the moon and recommends Tony for a more arduous test, Operation Extinction. Tony tells Jeannie he is taking her with him, but imprisons her within her bottle, de-termined to go on the mission alone.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)
programme.desc: Although the date hasn't been set, Tony forbids Jeannie from accompanying Melissa and himself on their honeymoon. Grover Caldwell, a young State Department attaché, tells Tony that General Stone, Melissa's father, has accepted an ambassadorial post. General Stone announces he hopes to take Tony, his prospective son-in-law, along as his military aide. When Tony expresses his desire to remain with the space program, Melissa, who has been working to advance the marriage date, tells her father she will change Tony's mind. She suggests that Grover replace Roger as Tony's best man.Jeannie, determined to accompany Tony, prepares an oriental feast when Melissa and her father dine at Tony's. Before serving, Jeannie turns herself into a Filipino houseboy. Melissa suggests they take the houseboy to Europe with them. Tony is given a bachelor dinner in which Jeannie emerges dancing from a prop cake. Jeannie learns that Grover is an old boy friend of Melissa's. Before Jeannie is through, Grover tells Melissa he loves her. Tony is not completely unhappy to be left with Jeannie, when Grover and Melissa declare their intentions to marry.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)
programme.desc: Jeannie gets jealous on discovering that Tony has a sexy new secretary. Claiming to be a better one, Jeannie insists on joining the WAAFs and taking over the job. Remembering that his friend, Roger Healey, told him that all new WAAFs are being sent overseas, Tony agrees to help Jeannie to join. To her horror, she is sent to San Antonio for basic training. Jeannie has a series of disastrous tryouts in different job categories, in spite of her insistence that she wants an assignment as Captain Nelson's secretary when she becomes a WAAF.When Major Margaret Fiefeld assigns Jeannie as secretary to the commanding officer at the North African base instead, Jeannie folds her arms, blinks, and lands in Tony's office. Tony informs Jeannie that he is being sent to Nevada. Jeannie says she will resign and go with him. Tony then tells her that only troublesome, incompetent girls are discharged and that she cannot resign. Jeannie blinks again, the office is set is turmoil, and Tony resignedly welcomes Jeannie back to civilian life.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)
programme.desc: After promising to spend an evening with Jeannie, Tony is tricked by his superiors into conducting aerospace tycoon P.J. Ferguson on a tour of the base. Ferguson's daughter, Nina, de-cides that Tony is her man. P.J. persuades Tony's superior to order Tony to have cocktails aboard his yacht. When Jeannie protests, Tony imprisons her in the vacuum cleaner. Later, after P.J. has Tony assigned to a cruise on his yacht, Mrs. Flaherty, Tony's cleaning woman, accidentally releases Jeannie from the vacuum cleaner. She immediately takes off for the yacht.Jeannie disappears from the yacht during an argument with Tony. Nina and P.J. are certain he has pushed her overboard. Charged with murder, Tony is arrested. Roger Healey, certain Tony has lost his mind, agrees to go to Tony's house and tell the walls and the vacuum cleaner of Tony's plight, Jeannie goes to Tony's cell. Her appearance convinces P.J. that Tony is innocent. Later, searching for privacy, Jeannie and Tony climb into her bottle.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)
programme.desc: After telling Tony that he and Roger Healey have been tapped for a historic two-man space probe, scheduled to blast off the following week, Dr. Bellows asks him to report for a final check-up. When Tony asks Jeannie to return to her home, Jeannie asserts that since Tony freed her from the bottle, she belongs to him. She adds that she can give him a space capsule of his own. Tony tells Jeannie if he fails tomorrow's test, he will not go on the flight.Worried about Tony's safety, Jeannie causes him to blurt out the wrong answers to every test. Tony leaves Dr. Bellows, certain he has passed, but Jeannie tells him he has failed. Impressed by Tony's unhappiness, Jeannie goes to Dr. Bellows' office, where he is typing a report on Tony's unfortunate condition. Resorting to all her magic, Jeannie makes Bellows believe that he is not only losing his mind, but is near death. Tony is reassigned to the two-man flight. There, in outer space, Jeannie joins Tony as he floats from a tether attached to the capsule.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)
programme.desc: Feeling that Jeannie must widen her horizons, Tony gives her a book "How To Be A Woman." Following the book's advice, to share her work with her man, Jeannie neglects her chores and allows the house to go to pot. Reading the chapter on clothing the successful woman, Jeannie charges an expensive wardrobe, in-cluding a mink coat. Convinced by the book that a man should take the woman out to dinner, Jeannie steers Tony to expensive Cafe Scheherazade. She starts a row when she criticizes the authen-ticity of the Arabian dancing.Literally taking the author's advice, Jeannie becomes a career girl and performs miraculous feats of instantaneous cooking while demonstrating electric stoves. Her employer, Sam, feeling she has been planted to get him into trouble with the Better Business Bureau, fires her. Later, after Tony feels he has straightened out things at home, Jeannie hears a news report about the flight of a Russian female astronaut. Blinking her eyes, she is outfitted as an astronaut and insists on accompanying Tony into space.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)
programme.desc: Tony is assigned as technical director on a new astronaut movie being filmed in Hollywood. Jealous of the star, Rita Mitchell, Jeannie smuggles herself along. All of Jeannie's ruses, including a rainstorm, fail to keep Tony from getting close to Rita. Tony tells Jeannie he is lunching with Rita and jokingly tells Jeannie he would lunch with her instead if she were a star. Determined to become a movie celebrity, Jeannie, seeing a picture of Pola Negri, patterns her personality on the old-time vamp.Although her first try at getting into the movies is viewed as a gag, Jeannie manages to get a screen test with Jason Huberts, which arouses Tony's jealousy. When the test with Jason and Jeannie is shown, only Jason is visible and Jeannie suddenly realizes that genies do not register on film. She is consoled when Tony breaks a date with Rita and they register their footprints in front of Grauman's Chinese with all the movie greats.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)
programme.desc: Jeannie gets involved with the law when, invisible to everyone, she attempts to drive Tony's car. Angered, Tony orders her to leave. Jeannie is aware that Tony has been studying the desalinization of seawater. Playing for time, she tells Tony her great-grandfather solved the problem. Tony asks to meet her great grandfather and Jeannie goes to get him. Tony phones Leslie Staples at the Department of Agriculture and tells him he is on the verge of converting salt water to fresh. Jeannie returns with her great grandfather, Bilejik, who proves that he can produce fresh water from salt water.When Tony returns to find Bilejik, Jeannie and a policeman are in front of his house. Bilejik has been causing all sorts of trouble with the neighbors. While resolving the matter, Tony discovers that Bilejik used seeds as a filter. After Bilejik leaves, Tony jubilantly reports to Staples. Staples tells him that these seeds are from a plant extinct for almost two thousand years.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)
programme.desc: A series of reports by eleven-year-old Custer to his father, Major Ulysses S. Jamison, on the strange feats of magic at Tony's house results in the Major taking his son to Dr. Bellows, the base psychiatrist. Bellows tells Custer he believes his story, and asks him to keep a close watch on Tony. A policeman catches Dr. Bellows and Custer peering into Tony's window and takes them inside for identification. While Bellows is telling Tony that Custer believes he has seen them levitate, Jeannie causes him to do so. Bellows bows out, feeling he has stumbled on a top-secret aerospace project.Tony voices his nervousness to Jeannie about being spied on by Custer. When Custer disappears, Tony accuses Jeannie of turning him into nothing. Angered, Jeannie leaves. Later, when Custer comes back, having spent the day at a carnival, Tony penitently begins searching for Jeannie. He is sure Jeannie has joined a carnival act and starts a riot at the sideshow when he mistakes a veiled woman for Jeannie. Jeannie returns home and starts pulling down all the shades to outwit Custer.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)
programme.desc: Jeannie is annoyed when Diane Rodney, a friend of Tony's, returns to town, determined to resume their old relationship. As a result, when Jeannie runs into Roger, while driving Tony's car, she accepts his invitation to dinner. Unaware that Jeannie is Roger's date, Tony instructs his friend in the fine art of courtship. Later, when Jeannie tells him she doesn't know her date's name, Tony begins to worry. When Diane arrives, Tony drags her all over town searching for Jeannie. The two couples finally meet at a nightclub. Alone with Jeannie, Tony demands she return home. Jeannie tells him she is going to listen to Roger's records.At Roger's apartment, Jeannie wards off all his attempts at romance. She leaves shortly before Tony pounds on the door looking for her. programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)
programme.desc: Unable to persuade Tony to marry her, Jeannie decides she needs a mother's counsel. She blinks her eyes and Mama appears. Making the house reappear, Jeannie produces parents for Roger's visit.Tony comes to the house and forbids Jeannie to marry Roger. Then Dr. Bellows drives up. programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)
programme.desc: Captain Tony Nelson, an astronaut, is engaged to Melissa Stone, daughter of General Wingard Stone, his commanding officer. Tony is rocketed into space in a capsule which lands is the Pacific. He reaches a small island. programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)
programme.sub-title: Guess What Happened On The Way To The Moon
programme.desc: To test man's ability to survive on the moon, Captain Anthony (Tony) Nelson, and his fellow astronaut, Captain Roger Healey, are ordered to spend a week, in Furnace Canyon, Nevada, 100 degrees in the daytime, 10 below freezing at night. Except for water, they are to live off the land. Jeannie hides in Tony's canteen. Tony tries to make Jeannie understand that she is destroying the value of the mission, but she sticks with him. While Roger barely survives, Tony has every luxury, from food and a harem tent, to a final ride on a camel to finish the journey.Dr. Bellows is baffled to find that while Roger has lost twelve pounds, Tony has gained five. When Tony tries to explain Jeannie's presence, Dr. Bellows concludes that he has the imagina-tion men need to survive on the moon and recommends Tony for a more arduous test, Operation Extinction. Tony tells Jeannie he is taking her with him, but imprisons her within her bottle, de-termined to go on the mission alone.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)
programme.desc: Although the date hasn't been set, Tony forbids Jeannie from accompanying Melissa and himself on their honeymoon. Grover Caldwell, a young State Department attaché, tells Tony that General Stone, Melissa's father, has accepted an ambassadorial post. General Stone announces he hopes to take Tony, his prospective son-in-law, along as his military aide. When Tony expresses his desire to remain with the space program, Melissa, who has been working to advance the marriage date, tells her father she will change Tony's mind. She suggests that Grover replace Roger as Tony's best man.Jeannie, determined to accompany Tony, prepares an oriental feast when Melissa and her father dine at Tony's. Before serving, Jeannie turns herself into a Filipino houseboy. Melissa suggests they take the houseboy to Europe with them. Tony is given a bachelor dinner in which Jeannie emerges dancing from a prop cake. Jeannie learns that Grover is an old boy friend of Melissa's. Before Jeannie is through, Grover tells Melissa he loves her. Tony is not completely unhappy to be left with Jeannie, when Grover and Melissa declare their intentions to marry.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)
programme.desc: Jeannie gets jealous on discovering that Tony has a sexy new secretary. Claiming to be a better one, Jeannie insists on joining the WAAFs and taking over the job. Remembering that his friend, Roger Healey, told him that all new WAAFs are being sent overseas, Tony agrees to help Jeannie to join. To her horror, she is sent to San Antonio for basic training. Jeannie has a series of disastrous tryouts in different job categories, in spite of her insistence that she wants an assignment as Captain Nelson's secretary when she becomes a WAAF.When Major Margaret Fiefeld assigns Jeannie as secretary to the commanding officer at the North African base instead, Jeannie folds her arms, blinks, and lands in Tony's office. Tony informs Jeannie that he is being sent to Nevada. Jeannie says she will resign and go with him. Tony then tells her that only troublesome, incompetent girls are discharged and that she cannot resign. Jeannie blinks again, the office is set is turmoil, and Tony resignedly welcomes Jeannie back to civilian life.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)
programme.desc: After promising to spend an evening with Jeannie, Tony is tricked by his superiors into conducting aerospace tycoon P.J. Ferguson on a tour of the base. Ferguson's daughter, Nina, de-cides that Tony is her man. P.J. persuades Tony's superior to order Tony to have cocktails aboard his yacht. When Jeannie protests, Tony imprisons her in the vacuum cleaner. Later, after P.J. has Tony assigned to a cruise on his yacht, Mrs. Flaherty, Tony's cleaning woman, accidentally releases Jeannie from the vacuum cleaner. She immediately takes off for the yacht.Jeannie disappears from the yacht during an argument with Tony. Nina and P.J. are certain he has pushed her overboard. Charged with murder, Tony is arrested. Roger Healey, certain Tony has lost his mind, agrees to go to Tony's house and tell the walls and the vacuum cleaner of Tony's plight, Jeannie goes to Tony's cell. Her appearance convinces P.J. that Tony is innocent. Later, searching for privacy, Jeannie and Tony climb into her bottle.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)
programme.desc: After telling Tony that he and Roger Healey have been tapped for a historic two-man space probe, scheduled to blast off the following week, Dr. Bellows asks him to report for a final check-up. When Tony asks Jeannie to return to her home, Jeannie asserts that since Tony freed her from the bottle, she belongs to him. She adds that she can give him a space capsule of his own. Tony tells Jeannie if he fails tomorrow's test, he will not go on the flight.Worried about Tony's safety, Jeannie causes him to blurt out the wrong answers to every test. Tony leaves Dr. Bellows, certain he has passed, but Jeannie tells him he has failed. Impressed by Tony's unhappiness, Jeannie goes to Dr. Bellows' office, where he is typing a report on Tony's unfortunate condition. Resorting to all her magic, Jeannie makes Bellows believe that he is not only losing his mind, but is near death. Tony is reassigned to the two-man flight. There, in outer space, Jeannie joins Tony as he floats from a tether attached to the capsule.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)
programme.desc: Feeling that Jeannie must widen her horizons, Tony gives her a book "How To Be A Woman." Following the book's advice, to share her work with her man, Jeannie neglects her chores and allows the house to go to pot. Reading the chapter on clothing the successful woman, Jeannie charges an expensive wardrobe, in-cluding a mink coat. Convinced by the book that a man should take the woman out to dinner, Jeannie steers Tony to expensive Cafe Scheherazade. She starts a row when she criticizes the authen-ticity of the Arabian dancing.Literally taking the author's advice, Jeannie becomes a career girl and performs miraculous feats of instantaneous cooking while demonstrating electric stoves. Her employer, Sam, feeling she has been planted to get him into trouble with the Better Business Bureau, fires her. Later, after Tony feels he has straightened out things at home, Jeannie hears a news report about the flight of a Russian female astronaut. Blinking her eyes, she is outfitted as an astronaut and insists on accompanying Tony into space.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)
programme.desc: Tony is assigned as technical director on a new astronaut movie being filmed in Hollywood. Jealous of the star, Rita Mitchell, Jeannie smuggles herself along. All of Jeannie's ruses, including a rainstorm, fail to keep Tony from getting close to Rita. Tony tells Jeannie he is lunching with Rita and jokingly tells Jeannie he would lunch with her instead if she were a star. Determined to become a movie celebrity, Jeannie, seeing a picture of Pola Negri, patterns her personality on the old-time vamp.Although her first try at getting into the movies is viewed as a gag, Jeannie manages to get a screen test with Jason Huberts, which arouses Tony's jealousy. When the test with Jason and Jeannie is shown, only Jason is visible and Jeannie suddenly realizes that genies do not register on film. She is consoled when Tony breaks a date with Rita and they register their footprints in front of Grauman's Chinese with all the movie greats.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)
programme.desc: Jeannie gets involved with the law when, invisible to everyone, she attempts to drive Tony's car. Angered, Tony orders her to leave. Tony asks to meet her great grandfather and Jeannie goes to get him. Tony phones Leslie Staples at the Department of Agriculture and tells him he is on the verge of converting salt water to fresh. Bilejik has been causing all sorts of trouble with the neighbors. While resolving the matter, Tony discovers that Bilejik used seeds as a filter. After Bilejik leaves, Tony jubilantly reports to Staples. Staples tells him that these seeds are from a plant extinct for almost two thousand years.

Jeannie returns home and starts pulling down all the shades to outwit Custer.

Later, dripping furs and jewelry, Sonya comes to Tony's home. She tells him Jeannie has granted her fondest desire by turning her into a wealthy American. Sonya agrees to return the bottle if Tony marries her. Tony asks a last word with Jeannie. He tells Jeannie he can't marry Sonya. Jeannie solves the problem by creating a duplicate Tony for Sonya.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)
programme.desc: Unable to persuade Tony to marry her, Jeannie decides she needs a mother's counsel. She blinks her eyes and Mama appears. Mama assures Jeannie Tony will change his mind if he thinks Jeannie is going to marry Roger. Tony asks Roger if he has met Jeannie's parents. Then Dr. Bellows announces he has bought the lot across the street. Roger asks to meet Jeannie's parents. She produces a house on Dr. Bellows' lot. Tony sees Dr. Bellows and General Hadley approaching the lot. Responding to Tony's pleas, Jeannie makes the house vanish. General Hadley and Dr. Bellows see Tony sitting in the weeds sipping tea. Making the house reappear, Jeannie produces parents for Roger's visit.Tony comes to the house and forbids Jeannie to marry Roger. Then Dr. Bellows drives up. Seeing the house, he becomes distraught, and runs to Tony. As the house disappears again, they see Roger sitting in the weeds. The following day, Roger tells Tony he found himself wandering around a vacant lot. When he returned to apologize, Jeannie and the house were gone. Smiling at Jeannie, hiding in his desk drawer, Tony assures Roger he Will let him know if he ever meets Jeannie again.

programme.title: Stugfixarna Norge
programme.desc: Resan går till sommarparadiset Arendal. Här har tiden stått stilla i det nästan 100 år gamla huset, och det blir pojkarnas uppgift att renovera det utan att förlora dess själ. Halvor har flera överraskningar i beredskap.

programme.title: Stugfixarna Norge: Avsnitt 105
programme.desc: Inredningsdesigner Halvor gör en resa till Telemark för att fixa till en sommarstuga på en ö som heter Skarveset vid kusten.

programme.title: Stugfixarna Norge: Avsnitt 405
programme.desc: I det här avsnittet gör killarna om rum så det känns som utomhus när du i själva verket är inomhus.

programme.title: Stugfixarna Norge
programme.desc: Den här gången står fisk på menyn. På ön Frei utanför Kristiansund möter vi familjen Furseth och deras gamla klipparfiskekvarn - och Halvor får visa upp både sin kreativitet och sina matlagningskunskaper.

programme.title: Stugfixarna Norge: Avsnitt 803
programme.desc: Urke är en liten by vid Hjørundfjorden. Här är den första A-stugan i programmet. Bland annat kommer en glasbox med stora fönster att byggas för den nya matsalen och takfönster kommer att tillverkas.

programme.title: Stugfixarna Norge: Avsnitt 205
programme.desc: En stuga på Lifjell i Telemark har stått orört i en halvt århundrade och är en härlig utgångspunkt för Halvor och teamet.

programme.title: Stugfixarna Norge: Avsnitt 304
programme.desc: Halvor och hans team åker till Geirangerfjorden för att fixa till en stuga med väldigt fin utsikt. Det otillgängliga läget har gjort det svårt för familjen att uppgradera stugan själva så nu ska Halvard och hans team blåsa nytt liv i den.

programme.title: Stugfixarna Norge: Avsnitt 907
programme.desc: Eventyrlig Oppussing är äntligen tillbaka på Svalbard. Stugan de renoverar har utsikt över Adventdalen och Gruve 7. Killarna upplever dramatik när en isbjörn upptäcks i området.

programme.title: Stugfixarna Norge: Avsnitt 504
programme.desc: Den här veckan påbörjar pojkarna en renovering som ägarna inte har ansökt om. Vid Værøy fyr utanför Lofoten tillbringar de sex dagar med en uppgift som ägarna tror tar fem till sex år.

programme.title: Stugfixarna Norge
programme.desc: Killarna åker till Hitra för att renovera vad som på håll ser ut som en fjällstuga. Det är tillbyggnader på tillbyggnader och turkosa färger som Halvor längtar efter att få städa upp.

programme.title: Stugfixarna Norge: Avsnitt 508
programme.desc: En gammal folkhögskolestuga omvandlas till en familjestuga och killarna kommer göra en drastisk förändring.

programme.title: Stugfixarna Norge: Avsnitt 703
programme.desc: Foreholmen är en gömd pärla i Flekkefjord. En mörk stuga förvandlas till ett ljust sommarparadis.

programme.title: Stugfixarna Norge: Avsnitt 301
programme.desc: En gammal lada i Bauge ska rustas upp och Halvor har sett att det finns en enorm potential bland balar och gamla jordbruskredskap.

programme.title: Stugfixarna Norge: Avsnitt 705

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Öland
programme.desc: Tareq bikes through the unique landscape of Öland, Sweden's second largest island located in the Baltic Sea. It is a place where the interaction between man and nature have created a diverse and rich farmland with an amazing amount of small producers.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Bornholm
programme.desc: Bornholm, the sunny bright green island with it’s own gastronomic tone is a true pioneer when it comes to local food at it’s finest quality. Tareq visit Denmark's first regional food culture house where they develop this unique flourishing cuisine.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Laponia
programme.desc: In the northern part of Sweden, you’ll find the stunning world heritage Laponia. Almost 10.000 square kilometres of nature reserves and national parks. Tareq visit the rich, unique culture of the sami in the vast impressive wilderness.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Malmö & Copenhagen
programme.desc: Tareq Taylor returns to his home turf to see what has happened and what the future might bring to the new nordic cuisine. He visits a local goat farmer and meets up with young enthusiastic chefs who takes this nordic legacy further.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Zealand
programme.desc: Tareq Taylor visits the South Coast of Denmark to make his own versions of open-faced sandwiches and smoked fish dishes.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Dalsland
programme.desc: Tareq Taylor puts on his hiking boots and explores the pilgrim trail of Dalsland in West Sweden. This episode will include outdoor cooking, foraging and beaver safari.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Stockholm
programme.desc: When Tareq arrives in Stockholm he will meet innovation and world class gastronomy, a big city for foodies. He will make some pizza at the Rosendal garden café and go on an adventure in the archipielago.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Lolland
programme.desc: When Michelin star chefs move from Copenhagen to the countryside, they often end up in Lolland/Falster. Here Tareq will meet Claus Meyer the father of new nordic cuisine and other entrepreneurs that opened interesting restaurants here.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Skåne
programme.desc: Tareq Taylor explores his own backyard of Skåne and hometown of Malmö, a multi cultural food mix. Here you can find food and culture from all over the world that makes it a unique culinary destination.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Best Of
programme.desc: Tareq Taylor looks back on some of the food adventures he has been part of in the program series Nordic Cookery. Tareq promises delicacies from all over the Nordics and meetings with fantastic people along the way.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Läckö & Kinnekulle
programme.desc: By Lake Vänern you find Läckö and Kinnekulle, an area rich in history, culture and traditions. Tareq cooks exciting dishes on vendice roe, fish and local cheeses - all served on porcelain from the world-famous Rörstrand.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Sjuhärad
programme.desc: Sjuhärad is nature and culture in perfect symbiosis. Tareq takes the bike to meet some of the food entrepreneurs in the area who have started exciting new businesses. Here you live close to nature, forest and lakes.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Greater Copenhagen
programme.desc: Copenhagen and Skåne are a hot food destinations. Tareq visits Østergro, Denmark's first "rooftop farm" in the middle of Copenhagen, Eden in the new district Hyllie, Malmö and Häckeberga Castle where there will be wild boar for dinner.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Höganäs
programme.desc: The wild coast at Kullaberg in Skåne has a lot of culture and gastronomy to offer. Fantastic ceramics, vineyards and world-class ice cream. Tareq visits VikenTomater and cooks vegetarian ragù

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Karlstad
programme.desc: Tareq visits sunny Karlstad! Here, food is prepared by Vänern's shores and in Värmland's deep forests. Butter-fried Zander, crepes and cooking over an open fire are on the menu.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Best Of (Part 2)
programme.desc: Once again, Tareq Taylor looks back on some of the food adventures he has been part of in the program series Nordic Cookery. Tareq promises delicacies from all over the Nordics and meetings with fantastic people along the way.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Lund
programme.desc: In this episode, Tareq visits Lund, a thousand-year old city in southern Sweden. Lund is surrounded by the richest farmland in the country, and we explore nearby islands and meet entrepreneurs making highly-regarded local products.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Bornholm
programme.desc: Tareq sails out to Bornholm, a Danish island close to southern tip of Sweden. The islanders are fiercely self-sufficient and this attitude reflects in the huge number of food producers making products that are sold both locally and internationally.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Jokkmokk
programme.desc: Far above the Arctic Circle, Tareq explores the wild country around Jokkmokk. Here, the Sami people lived from what the land provides for thousands of years. This wild cuisine is as extreme as the weather here.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Åland
programme.desc: For hundreds of years, Åland’s shipping fleet was the envy of navies around the world, and their sea trade was encouraged by the seafood, grains and fruits that thrive on these islands. Tareq prepares recipes to reflect Åland’s unique cuisine.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Malmö
programme.desc: Tareq is in his hometown of Malmö – Sweden’s third largest city. The food scene here is inspired by the traditional seafood dishes and the large immigrant population whose recipes have given Malmö a new energy.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Finland's South Coast
programme.desc: Tareq takes a late autumn trip along Finland’s southern coast. He stops in the capital Helsinki to see how the city's food culture is about to be discovered by the rest of the world, and dives into the freezing waters around Ekenäs.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Kiruna
programme.desc: Tareq arrives in Kiruna, over 200km north of the Arctic Circle. With the weather getting down to -30C, Tareq takes part in snow picnics, firing up the smoker, and using snow and ice as part of the recipes he prepares.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Bergen
programme.desc: Surrounded by some of the most beautiful landscapes in northern Europe, Bergen has become a centre for the finest seafood in northern Europe. Tareq heads into this winter wonderland to see the curious cuisine that has developed in western Norway.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: The Faroe Islands
programme.desc: Tareq comes to understand what is in the soul of the Faroese, and why their cuisine has developed the way it has. We explore the beautiful capital Torshavn and surrounding villages, and sail into a cave for a recipe prepared on a rowboat.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Central Jutland
programme.desc: Volcanoes and glaciers shaped this part of the country, leaving a giant fjord and pre-historic fossils in their wake. Farmers and food innovators work closely with nature to prepare food with the area’s plentiful herbs and award-winning seafood.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Åland (Part 2)
programme.desc: Tareq goes back to Åland to explore more of this island territory. Tareq finds a chef setting up a huge food village, sees forts left over from various invaders over the centuries, and learns about beer being recreated from 200 year old DNA.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Tornedalen
programme.desc: There are not many places like Tornedalen. A rushing river has provided for locals for centuries, and the very fertile land has yielded amazing crops for centuries.Tareq explores the traditions and the food that are part of the short summer season.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: North Jutland
programme.desc: At the northern-most part of Denmark, you are always close to raw, beautiful nature, and incredible sunlight that has drawn artists here for over 100 years. Tareq visits a salt maker using medieval techniques and experiences the magic light of Skagen.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: East Denmark
programme.desc: East Denmark contains some of Denmark’s most fertile lands, and many traditional farmers are converting to organic production and winning awards for their cheeses and wine. Tareq bikes through an area of limestone cliffs and Viking ships.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Kristianstad
programme.desc: Located in Sweden’s south, beautiful Kristianstad is a 400-year old town surrounded by the ocean, fertile farmland and protected wetlands to aid the environment. Tareq makes his own chocolate and learns all about the art of eel-fishing.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Kristianstad

programme.title: The Hills: I'm Done With You
programme.desc: Heidi kommer på Spencer med bartendern Stacie på en nattklubb och kräver att de ska gå i parterapi. Lauren riskerar sitt goda rykte när hon rekommenderar att People's Revolution ska ta in Stephanie som praktikant.

programme.title: The Hills: Crazy In Love
programme.desc: Audrina försöker kommer över Justin genom att lägga ögonen på Brody. Heidi tvingar med sig Spencer på parterapi och när Stephanie strular till det på People´s Revolution hotar Lauren med att säga upp henne.

programme.title: The Hills: I Always Had A Little Crush
programme.sub-title: I Always Had A Little Crush
programme.desc: Audrina försöker komma över Justin genom att haka upp med Brody när flickorna krascha pojkarnas surfa resa till Hawaii. Heidis jungfru ex-pojkvän kommer på besök och hon hoppas några av hans värderingar kommer att smitta av sig på Spencer.

programme.title: The Hills: Playmates Bring the Drama
programme.desc: Audrinas hjärta krossas när Brodys flickvän konfronterar henne med frågor om Hawaii och Brody gör ingenting för att stoppa henne. Heidi läser ett sms från Stacie till Spencer och drar till en nattklubb för att konfrontera henne.

programme.title: The Hills: Keep Your Enemies Closer
programme.desc: Justin konfronterar Audrina om att hon strulade med Brody på Hawaii. Stephanie förstör en fotografering på jobbet och Lauren ställs till svars inför Kelly. Bartendern Stacie försöker att bli sams med Heidi.

programme.title: The Hills: Father of The Bride
programme.desc: Spencer försöker att rädda förhållandet med Heidi genom att be hennes far om hennes hand. Lauren tvingas att avskeda Stephanie från People's Revolution - vilket riskerar att förstöra deras vänskap.

programme.title: The Hills: Hi Lauren, It's Spencer
programme.desc: Lauren är tveksam om hon ska gå på Heidis bröllop efter det att Spencer äntligen bett om ursäkt. Brody vägrar att riskera vänskapen med Jayde för att rädda förhållandet med Audrina - och Stephanie konfronterar Kelly Cutrone.

programme.title: The Hills: Something Old, Something New
programme.desc: I Laurens sista avsnitt måste hon bestämma sig för om hon kan förlåta Spencer och stötta Heidi på hennes prinsessbröllop. Alla är där - och blir chockerade när en oväntad gäst dyker upp.

programme.title: The Hills: It's On Bitch
programme.desc: Kristin startar krig när hon flörtar med Justin framför näsan på Audrina. Trots att de letar ny bostad tillsammans köper Spencer en utan att Heidi godkänt det.

programme.title: The Hills: Mess With Me, I Mess With You
programme.sub-title: Mess With Me, I Mess With You
programme.desc: Efter att Audrina struntat i henne, beslutar sig Kristin för att inte kämpa emot att hon är så attraherad av Justin. Heidi erbjuder sig att sitta barnvakt åt grannen, men Spencer vill inte ha nåt med barn att göra.

programme.title: The Hills: Strike One
programme.desc: Kristin får känna på hur det är att vara i ett förhållande med Justin när han aldrig dyker upp på Brodys överraskningsfest. Heidi och Spencer är inte överens om när de ska skaffa barn, och Audrina går på dejt med Justins bäste vän.

programme.title: The Hills: Old Habits Die Hard
programme.desc: Kristin tror att hon har tämjt Justin, men han har kanske inte kommit över Audrina än. När Holly ballar ur på ett event så tvingas Heidi ta upp hennes alkoholproblem med sin syster.

programme.title: The Hills: Sorry Boo, Strike Two
programme.desc: Justin spelar svårfångad med Kristin, men hans plan går i stöpet. Hollys supande gör att Heidi och Stephanie ordnar en intervention. Brody och Jayde börjar slåss och tvingas tänka över sin vänskap.

programme.title: The Hills: I'm Done With You
programme.desc: Justin hamnar på hal is efter det att Kristin och Audrina till slut träffats. Det enda Heidi vill ha i födelsedagspresent är en bebis, men Spencer har siktet inställt på nåt helt annat.

programme.title: The Hills: On To The Next
programme.desc: Kristin och Brody funderar på att börja dejta igen, men när de träffar Jayde inser de att tidpunkten är fel. Audrina och Justin diskuterar sin framtid, men det slutar inte som hon hoppats. Spencer tar till drastiska metoder mot Heidis bebisdrömmar.

programme.title: The Hills: Can't Always Get What You Want
programme.sub-title: Can't Always Get What You Want
programme.desc: Kristin och Jayde hamnar i bråk när hon försöker att få tillbaka Brody. Heidi planerar att bli gravid vare sig Spencer vill det eller inte, och Audrina bearbetar det faktum att Justin fortfarande har känslor för Kristin.

programme.title: The Hills: Mr. Right Now
programme.desc: Kristin vill inte bli ihop med Justin, men han ger sig inte utan kamp och Audrina gör slut med Justin för gott. Brody får kalla fötter när Jayde vill flytta in hos honom och Spencer har ångest över att Heidi kan vara gravid.

programme.title: The Hills: The Boys Of Summer
programme.desc: Kristin och Justin tar förhållandet till nästa nivå och Spencer konfronterar Heidi om gravtestet. Brody kanske fortfarande hyser känslor för Kristin efter det att Jayde talat ut om deras förhållande på en förlovningsfest.

programme.title: The Hills: Put On A Happy Face
programme.desc: Det blir inte roligt för Heidi att komma hem när mamma ogillar att hon gjort plastikkirurgi. Kristin och tjejerna åker till Miami för Super Bowl-helgen, men resan går snett när hennes festande börjar oroa Audrina, Lo och Stephanie.

programme.title: The Hills: Rumor Has It
programme.desc: När det börjar gå rykten om Kristins festande får Stephanie skulden. Audrina börjar dejta en ny kille, men det hindrar inte Brody från att jaga henne. Spencer blir upprörd när han springer på Stephanie på Kristins fest.

programme.title: The Hills: The Elephant In The Room
programme.desc: Heidi har fest för sin granne, men festen hamnar i skymundan när Spencer blir arg på Holly. Kristin tycker att Audrina ska vara med Ryan och försöker sen komma närmare Brody.

programme.title: The Hills: This Is Goodbye
programme.desc: Heidis och Spencers beteende tvingar deras vänner och familjer att göra ett svårt val. Kristin och Brody får ihop det, men båda vill hellre vara singel. Ryan gör Audrina besviken när han aldrig dyker upp trots att de ska gå ut.

programme.title: The Hills: A New Bird
programme.desc: Brody riskerar sin vänskap med Kristin när han börjar gå ut med en ny tjej. Lo ordnar en dubbeldejt åt Stephanie. Ryan ger Audrinas vänner en ny chans.

programme.title: The Hills: Ghost From The Past
programme.desc: Kristin har svårt att gå vidare från Brody. Audrina råkar på Justin och börjar tveka över sitt förhållande med Ryan. Lo slår upp en bekantskap med Brodys nya flickvän.

programme.title: The Hills: The Company You Keep
programme.desc: Brodys nya kärlek gör Kristin till sin fiende när hon tar med en gammal rival till Kristins fest. Ryan kommer hem från turnén, men Audrina berättar inte att hon träffade Justin medan han var bortrest.

programme.title: The Hills: Between A Rocker And A Hard Place
programme.sub-title: Between A Rocker And A Hard Place
programme.desc: Audrinas förhållande med Ryan sätts på prov när han träffar Justin för första gången. Brody tar Kristins parti när Aliie börjar bråka med henne. Stephanie går på en andra dejt, men den är en besvikelse.

programme.title: The Hills: Break-Up to Make-Up
programme.desc: I samma veva som Audrina gör slut med Ryan överraskar Justin henne på födelsedagen. McKaelas vän Allie ställer till mer bråk för Kristin. Brody säger ett sanningens ord till Justin.

programme.title: The Hills: Welcome to the Jungle
programme.desc: När hela gruppen åker till Costa Rica för att surfa gör blir Brody svartsjuk när Kristin får ihop det med en bartender. Audrina försöker förneka sin attraktion till Justin, och Stephanie passar inte in i djungelmiljön.

programme.title: The Hills: Loves Me Not
programme.desc: Kristin och Brody talar ut och hon berättar att hon vill att de försöker på nytt. Heidis mamma besöker LA i hopp om en återförening. Lo och hennes pojkvän firar årsdag, och Stephanie börjar dejta en ny kille.

programme.title: The Hills: All Good Things...
programme.desc: Kristin står inför ett stort beslut som även påverkar Brody. Audrina gör slut med Justin. Lo vet inte om hon är redo för nästa steg med sin pojkvän och Stephanie tror att hon äntligen funnit den rätte.

programme.title: The Hills: New Beginnings: I Don't Hold Grudges... JK!
programme.desc: En nystart för detta kompisgäng när de återvänder till The Hills och träffar varann för första gången på länge. De ställs inför nya utmaningar, men gamla rivaliteter och romanser ställer till det. Ibland är det förflutna inte förflutet.

programme.title: The Hills: New Beginnings: You're Not My Family
programme.desc: Stephanie försöker att lappa ihop sin relation med brodern Spencer, Mischa säger ifrån till Perez Hilton som mobbade henne när hon var i stjärnljuset. Det slår gnistor mellan Audrina och Justin, men Justin verkar ha fått ögonen på en till.

programme.title: The Hills: New Beginnings: A Legend in His Own Mind
programme.sub-title: A Legend in His Own Mind
programme.desc: Audrina får veta nåt chockerande om Justin Bobby som får henne att tvivla på hans motiv. Det går hett till när Spencer och Heidi ifrågasätter sin vänskap med Brody. Samtidigt har Brandon Thomas Lee poolfest hos sin mamma.

programme.title: The Hills: New Beginnings: Not to Eavesdrop, But to Eavesdrop
programme.sub-title: Not to Eavesdrop, But to Eavesdrop
programme.desc: Audrina konfronterar Justin när han förnekar att han kysst henne. Brody funderar över sina relationer till sin far Caitlyn och vän Spencer. Spencer och Heidi försöker få verksamheten att växa vilket sätter deras förhållande på prov.

programme.title: The Hills: New Beginnings: Playing with Fire
programme.desc: Gänget åker till Vegas för att se Brodys DJ-uppträdande, och Justin hamnar mitt i en uppgörelse mellan Audrina och Stephanie. En skogsbrand härjar i Malibu, och Kaitlynn fruktar för Brodys liv när han stannar i evakueringszonen.

programme.title: The Hills: New Beginnings: I Don't Think We Can Be Friends
programme.sub-title: I Don't Think We Can Be Friends
programme.desc: Brody och Kaitlynn får se förödelsen efter bränderna i Malibu. Audrina fattar ett svårt beslut som gäller Justin. Under tiden går Mischa på en viktig audition och Heidi börjar återuppliva sin popstjärnekarriär.

programme.title: The Hills: New Beginnings: You're Enemy #1
programme.desc: Skvallret tar fart och rykten sprids efter en incident med Brody och Stephanie. Audrina får en chock när Justin tar med en snygg tjej på middagen.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Raw Greed
programme.desc: A friendly Midwest lodge becomes the scene of a gruesome double murder. Two men are dead and a safe filled with cash is missing.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Silent Witness
programme.desc: Three hairs, microscopic fibers, a common trash bag ripped from a roll. Seemingly small and insignificant clues become a victim's silent witness.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Blood Money
programme.desc: Some people murder for love. But these killers did it for the money. When greed is the motive, investigators must make every clue pay off.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Coroner's Casebook
programme.desc: A good coroner provides what's necessary to solve a crime. A bad one can spoil an otherwise rock-solid case. Cyril Wecht and Henry Lee, two of the country's most respected coroners, share their cases and insights into crime solving.

credits.actor: Shawn Arledge Jean Croce Tony Ellis

programme.title: The New Detectives: Absent Witness
programme.desc: When killers hide or destroy the remains of their victims, it becomes the mission of forensic scientists to reconstruct the scenes and prove murder for an absent witness.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Dead Men Do Talk
programme.desc: Profiles the work of world-renowned forensic experts and the procedures they use to solve murders and other mysteries in minutes or centuries after they happen.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Web of Clues
programme.desc: Forensic Entomology: Bugs have roamed the earth for 250 million years, but their intimate association with death is just now coming to life.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Fateful Twist
programme.desc: A southeastern Virginia community is stunned by a crime no one can believe. A pregnant woman murdered, her baby lost. Across the state, another town feels a similar shock, a brutal, random slaying in a most unexpected setting.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Marked For Death
programme.desc: Sometimes killers are careful to leave no fingerprints behind. But methods of the murder itself can leave a lasting impression on police, especially when the tools (or weapons) of a killer's trade leave an innocent victim marked for death.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Trails of Evidence
programme.desc: In criminal investigations, a simple clue can provide the missing link by placing a suspect at a crime scene. Dirt left on shoes, tires or clothes, or even a tiny piece of plastic can pinpoint a crime scene.

programme.title: The New Detectives: A Deadly Smile
programme.desc: Investigators rely on forensic odontology to identify a body from a single tooth and to catch two brutal killers from their bite marks.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Remnant of Blame
programme.desc: The solution to the most heinous crimes often hinge on the smallest of clues. Investigators must have their eyes trained to find the full story of a murder written in a single scrap of evidence.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Family Plots
programme.desc: Every family has its secrets, and sometimes blood relations lead to bloodshed. When murder becomes a family affair, investigators must turn to forensics to uncover family plots.

programme.title: The New Detectives: In the Camera's Eye
programme.desc: Photography has long been a vital tool in homicide investigations. A single image captures enough information to identify a suspect, and to preserve a vital clue long after a witness' memory fades.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Deadly Aim
programme.desc: Ballistic analysis is the key to finding killers who turn guns on their victims. Each shot fired leaves its own "fingerprint", allowing scientists to target murderers with deadly aim.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Trial Of The Century
programme.desc: Forensics in the O.J. Simpson Murder Trial: Millions watched on television as the jury rendered their verdict. Orenthal James Simpson was found not guilty of murder.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Betrayed
programme.desc: Sometimes when a death seems to be accidental or the result of a tragic accident, it is up to forensic scientists to reveal the deception lying just below the surface.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Out Of The Grave
programme.desc: New Forensic Techniques used to Solve Old Cases: Advancement in science and technology are encouraging people to revisit the past in hopes of answering questions that have remained unanswered, and solving crimes that seemed unsolvable.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Buried Secrets
programme.desc: Forensic scientists find clues written in blood as they investigate the deaths of three women killed by the men who once loved them.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Buried Secrets
programme.desc: Forensic scientists find clues written in blood as they investigate the deaths of three women killed by the men who once loved them.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Body Count
programme.desc: Some people do get away with murder, at least for a while. Flush with their success, serial killers murder again and again. But each time they kill, they leave behind a few more clues, which ultimately lead to their undoing.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Body Count
